# =============================================================
# Agri LMS — Enrollment Model
# =============================================================
# File    : app/models/enrollment.py
# Purpose : Defines the Enrollment database model representing
#           the formal relationship between a learner and a
#           course they have joined.
#
#           An Enrollment is created when a learner clicks
#           "Enroll" on a course. It tracks the full lifecycle
#           of a learner's journey through a course — from
#           enrollment date through to completion, including
#           their overall progress percentage, final score,
#           and certificate eligibility.
#
#           This model is the central linking table between
#           the User and Course models, and it is the primary
#           source of truth for:
#               - Whether a learner has access to a course
#               - How far through the course a learner is
#               - Whether a learner has completed the course
#               - Whether a learner passed and earned a certificate
#
# Relationships:
#   Enrollment >── User     (many enrollments belong to one user)
#   Enrollment >── Course   (many enrollments belong to one course)
#
# Enrollment Lifecycle:
#   Learner clicks Enroll
#       → Enrollment created (status='pending' if approval needed
#                             status='active' if open enrollment)
#       → Learner accesses modules
#       → progress_percent updates as modules are completed
#       → final_score calculated from assignment grades
#       → is_completed set True when last module is done
#       → is_passed set True if final_score >= course passing_score
#       → certificate_issued set True if eligible
# =============================================================

from datetime import datetime
from app.extensions import db


# =============================================================
# ENROLLMENT STATUS CONSTANTS
# =============================================================

ENROLLMENT_STATUS_PENDING   = 'pending'     # Awaiting admin approval
ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE    = 'active'      # Approved and learning
ENROLLMENT_STATUS_COMPLETED = 'completed'   # Finished all modules
ENROLLMENT_STATUS_SUSPENDED = 'suspended'   # Temporarily blocked
ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DROPPED   = 'dropped'     # Learner withdrew

ENROLLMENT_STATUSES = [
    ENROLLMENT_STATUS_PENDING,
    ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE,
    ENROLLMENT_STATUS_COMPLETED,
    ENROLLMENT_STATUS_SUSPENDED,
    ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DROPPED,
]


# =============================================================
# ENROLLMENT MODEL
# =============================================================

class Enrollment(db.Model):
    """
    Represents a single learner's enrollment in a single course.

    Each Enrollment record is unique per learner per course —
    enforced by the uq_enrollment_user_course constraint.
    A learner cannot enroll in the same course twice.

    The enrollment tracks:
        - Access status (active, pending, suspended, dropped)
        - Progress through the course (progress_percent)
        - Completion status (is_completed)
        - Pass/fail status (is_passed)
        - Final score (final_score from graded assignments)
        - Certificate eligibility (certificate_issued)
    """

    __tablename__ = 'enrollments'

    # ── Table-level constraints ───────────────────────────────
    __table_args__ = (
        # One learner can only enroll in a course once
        db.UniqueConstraint(
            'user_id',
            'course_id',
            name='uq_enrollment_user_course'
        ),
    )

    # ── Primary Key ───────────────────────────────────────────
    id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        primary_key=True,
        autoincrement=True,
        comment='Unique enrollment identifier — auto-incremented primary key'
    )

    # ── Foreign Keys ──────────────────────────────────────────
    user_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        db.ForeignKey('users.id', ondelete='CASCADE'),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
        comment=(
            'Foreign key — ID of the learner who enrolled. '
            'CASCADE: deleting a user removes all their enrollments.'
        )
    )

    course_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        db.ForeignKey('courses.id', ondelete='CASCADE'),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
        comment=(
            'Foreign key — ID of the course the learner enrolled in. '
            'CASCADE: deleting a course removes all its enrollments.'
        )
    )

    # ── Enrollment Status ─────────────────────────────────────
    status = db.Column(
        db.String(20),
        nullable=False,
        default=ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        comment=(
            'Current status of this enrollment. '
            'pending: awaiting admin approval | '
            'active: learner has full course access | '
            'completed: all modules finished | '
            'suspended: access temporarily blocked | '
            'dropped: learner withdrew from the course'
        )
    )

    is_active = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=True,
        comment=(
            'Quick access flag derived from status. '
            'True when status is active or completed. '
            'False when pending, suspended, or dropped. '
            'Used for fast filtering without string comparison.'
        )
    )

    # ── Progress Tracking ─────────────────────────────────────
    progress_percent = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(5, 2),
        nullable=False,
        default=0.00,
        comment=(
            'Overall course progress as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). '
            'Calculated as: (completed modules / total published modules) * 100. '
            'Updated automatically each time a learner completes a module.'
        )
    )

    modules_completed = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        nullable=False,
        default=0,
        comment=(
            'Running count of how many modules this learner '
            'has marked as complete in this course.'
        )
    )

    last_accessed_module_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        db.ForeignKey('modules.id', ondelete='SET NULL'),
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Foreign key — ID of the last module the learner '
            'opened or was viewing. Used to resume learning '
            'from where they left off.'
        )
    )

    # ── Completion ────────────────────────────────────────────
    is_completed = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'Course completion flag. '
            'Set to True automatically when the learner completes '
            'the module where is_last_module=True. '
            'Once True, the system calculates final_score '
            'and determines is_passed.'
        )
    )

    date_completed = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'UTC timestamp of when the learner completed '
            'the final module and is_completed was set to True.'
        )
    )

    # ── Scoring and Grading ───────────────────────────────────
    final_score = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(5, 2),
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Final averaged score across all graded assignments '
            'for this course enrollment. Expressed as a percentage. '
            'Calculated when the course is completed or on demand.'
        )
    )

    is_passed = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Pass/fail flag. '
            'Set to True if final_score >= course.passing_score. '
            'Null until the course is completed and scored.'
        )
    )

    # ── Certificate ───────────────────────────────────────────
    certificate_issued = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'Certificate issuance flag. '
            'True when: is_completed=True AND is_passed=True '
            'AND course.certificate_available=True. '
            'Enables the certificate download link for the learner.'
        )
    )

    certificate_issued_date = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        comment='UTC timestamp of when the certificate was issued to the learner.'
    )

    # ── Admin Notes ───────────────────────────────────────────
    admin_notes = db.Column(
        db.Text,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Internal admin-only notes about this enrollment — '
            'e.g. special accommodations, approval reasons, '
            'suspension reasons. Not visible to the learner.'
        )
    )

    # ── Timestamps ────────────────────────────────────────────
    date_enrolled = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=False,
        default=datetime.utcnow,
        comment='UTC timestamp of when the learner submitted the enrollment request.'
    )

    date_approved = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'UTC timestamp of when an admin approved this enrollment. '
            'Null for courses that do not require approval.'
        )
    )

    date_updated = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        onupdate=datetime.utcnow,
        comment='UTC timestamp of the most recent update to this enrollment record.'
    )

    # ── Relationships ─────────────────────────────────────────

    # The last module the learner accessed — for resume functionality
    last_accessed_module = db.relationship(
        'Module',
        foreign_keys=[last_accessed_module_id],
        lazy='joined'
    )

    # ==========================================================
    # STATUS MANAGEMENT METHODS
    # ==========================================================

    def activate(self):
        """
        Activate this enrollment, granting the learner
        full access to the course content.

        Sets status to 'active', is_active to True,
        and records the approval timestamp.

        Typical use: Admin approves a pending enrollment.
        """
        self.status = ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE
        self.is_active = True
        self.date_approved = datetime.utcnow()

    def suspend(self, reason=None):
        """
        Suspend this enrollment, temporarily blocking
        the learner from accessing the course.

        Args:
            reason (str, optional): Reason for suspension
                                    stored in admin_notes.
        """
        self.status = ENROLLMENT_STATUS_SUSPENDED
        self.is_active = False
        if reason:
            self.admin_notes = (
                f'[SUSPENDED {datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}]: '
                f'{reason}\n'
                + (self.admin_notes or '')
            )

    def drop(self, reason=None):
        """
        Mark this enrollment as dropped, indicating the
        learner has voluntarily withdrawn from the course.

        Args:
            reason (str, optional): Reason for dropping
                                    stored in admin_notes.
        """
        self.status = ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DROPPED
        self.is_active = False
        if reason:
            self.admin_notes = (
                f'[DROPPED {datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}]: '
                f'{reason}\n'
                + (self.admin_notes or '')
            )

    def mark_completed(self, final_score=None, passing_score=50.0):
        """
        Mark this enrollment as completed.

        Sets is_completed to True, records the completion
        timestamp, calculates pass/fail status, and
        determines certificate eligibility.

        Args:
            final_score (float, optional): The learner's
                averaged assignment score as a percentage.
            passing_score (float): The minimum score required
                to pass. Defaults to 50.0 if not provided.

        Typical use: Called automatically when a learner
        completes the module flagged as is_last_module=True.
        """
        self.is_completed = True
        self.status = ENROLLMENT_STATUS_COMPLETED
        self.date_completed = datetime.utcnow()

        if final_score is not None:
            self.final_score = round(final_score, 2)
            self.is_passed = float(final_score) >= float(passing_score)
        else:
            # No graded assignments — completion counts as pass
            self.is_passed = True

    def issue_certificate(self):
        """
        Issue a completion certificate to this learner
        if they are eligible.

        Eligibility requires:
            - is_completed must be True
            - is_passed must be True
            - Certificate not already issued

        Returns:
            bool: True if the certificate was issued,
                  False if the learner is not eligible
                  or certificate was already issued.
        """
        if self.is_completed and self.is_passed and not self.certificate_issued:
            self.certificate_issued = True
            self.certificate_issued_date = datetime.utcnow()
            return True
        return False

    # ==========================================================
    # PROGRESS METHODS
    # ==========================================================

    def update_progress(self, total_published_modules):
        """
        Recalculate and update the progress_percent field
        based on the current modules_completed count and
        the total number of published modules in the course.

        This method should be called every time a learner
        completes a new module.

        Args:
            total_published_modules (int): Total number of
                published modules in the course.

        Example:
            If 3 of 5 modules are complete:
            update_progress(5) → progress_percent = 60.00
        """
        if total_published_modules <= 0:
            self.progress_percent = 0.00
            return

        percent = (self.modules_completed / total_published_modules) * 100
        self.progress_percent = round(min(percent, 100.00), 2)

    def increment_modules_completed(self):
        """
        Increment the modules_completed counter by one.
        Should be called when a learner marks a module complete.
        """
        self.modules_completed += 1

    def get_progress_display(self):
        """
        Format the progress_percent as a clean percentage
        string for display in templates and dashboards.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted percentage string.

        Examples:
            0.00  → '0%'
            66.67 → '66.67%'
            100.0 → '100%'
        """
        if not self.progress_percent:
            return '0%'
        value = float(self.progress_percent)
        if value == int(value):
            return f'{int(value)}%'
        return f'{value:.2f}%'

    def get_days_since_enrollment(self):
        """
        Calculate the number of days that have passed
        since the learner enrolled in this course.

        Returns:
            int: Number of days since enrollment.
        """
        delta = datetime.utcnow() - self.date_enrolled
        return delta.days

    def get_days_to_complete(self):
        """
        Calculate how many days it took for the learner
        to complete the course.

        Returns:
            int or None: Days from enrollment to completion.
                         None if course is not yet completed.
        """
        if self.is_completed and self.date_completed:
            delta = self.date_completed - self.date_enrolled
            return delta.days
        return None

    # ==========================================================
    # STATUS CHECK HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def is_pending(self):
        """
        Check whether this enrollment is awaiting
        admin approval.

        Returns:
            bool: True if status is 'pending'.
        """
        return self.status == ENROLLMENT_STATUS_PENDING

    def is_suspended(self):
        """
        Check whether this enrollment is currently
        suspended by an admin.

        Returns:
            bool: True if status is 'suspended'.
        """
        return self.status == ENROLLMENT_STATUS_SUSPENDED

    def is_dropped(self):
        """
        Check whether the learner has dropped
        this course.

        Returns:
            bool: True if status is 'dropped'.
        """
        return self.status == ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DROPPED

    def can_access_content(self):
        """
        Determine whether this learner currently has
        permission to access the course content.

        Access is granted only when the enrollment
        status is active or completed.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the learner can view course content.
        """
        return self.status in (
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_COMPLETED
        )

    def get_status_badge_class(self):
        """
        Return a CSS class name corresponding to the
        current enrollment status for badge styling
        in templates.

        Returns:
            str: CSS class string for the status badge.
        """
        badge_classes = {
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_PENDING:   'badge-warning',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE:    'badge-success',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_COMPLETED: 'badge-primary',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_SUSPENDED: 'badge-danger',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DROPPED:   'badge-secondary',
        }
        return badge_classes.get(self.status, 'badge-secondary')

    def get_status_label(self):
        """
        Return a human-readable label for the current
        enrollment status.

        Returns:
            str: Capitalized status label.
        """
        labels = {
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_PENDING:   'Pending Approval',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_ACTIVE:    'Active',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_COMPLETED: 'Completed',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_SUSPENDED: 'Suspended',
            ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DROPPED:   'Dropped',
        }
        return labels.get(self.status, 'Unknown')

    # ==========================================================
    # SERIALIZATION
    # ==========================================================

    def to_dict(self):
        """
        Serialize the Enrollment object to a plain dictionary
        suitable for JSON responses and template rendering.

        Returns:
            dict: Enrollment data with all computed fields.
        """
        return {
            'id':                       self.id,
            'user_id':                  self.user_id,
            'course_id':                self.course_id,
            'status':                   self.status,
            'status_label':             self.get_status_label(),
            'status_badge_class':       self.get_status_badge_class(),
            'is_active':                self.is_active,
            'progress_percent':         float(self.progress_percent)
                                        if self.progress_percent else 0.0,
            'progress_display':         self.get_progress_display(),
            'modules_completed':        self.modules_completed,
            'last_accessed_module_id':  self.last_accessed_module_id,
            'is_completed':             self.is_completed,
            'date_completed':           self.date_completed.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.date_completed else None,
            'final_score':              float(self.final_score)
                                        if self.final_score else None,
            'is_passed':                self.is_passed,
            'certificate_issued':       self.certificate_issued,
            'certificate_issued_date':  self.certificate_issued_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.certificate_issued_date else None,
            'can_access_content':       self.can_access_content(),
            'days_since_enrollment':    self.get_days_since_enrollment(),
            'days_to_complete':         self.get_days_to_complete(),
            'admin_notes':              self.admin_notes,
            'date_enrolled':            self.date_enrolled.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
            'date_approved':            self.date_approved.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.date_approved else None,
            'date_updated':             self.date_updated.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.date_updated else None,
        }

    # ==========================================================
    # STRING REPRESENTATION
    # ==========================================================

    def __repr__(self):
        return (
            f'<Enrollment id={self.id} '
            f'user_id={self.user_id} '
            f'course_id={self.course_id} '
            f'status={self.status!r} '
            f'progress={self.progress_percent}%>'
        )

# =============================================================
# Agri LMS — Grade Model
# =============================================================
# File    : app/models/grade.py
# Purpose : Defines the Grade database model representing an
#           admin's evaluation of a learner's submission.
#
#           A Grade record is created by an admin when they
#           review and score a learner's Submission. Each
#           Submission can have at most one Grade record —
#           enforced by the unique constraint on submission_id
#           and by the one-to-one relationship defined on
#           the Submission model.
#
#           The Grade stores:
#               - The raw score awarded (score_awarded)
#               - The maximum possible score (max_score)
#               - The calculated percentage (score_percent)
#               - Written feedback from the admin (feedback)
#               - A rubric breakdown (rubric_scores) for
#                 detailed criterion-by-criterion scoring
#               - Whether the submission passed (is_passed)
#               - Whether the learner has been notified
#
#           When a Grade is saved, the following happens
#           automatically through the post-save logic in
#           the route handler:
#               1. Submission.is_graded is set to True
#               2. Submission.score_percent is updated
#               3. Submission.status is set to 'graded'
#               4. Enrollment.final_score is recalculated
#                  by averaging all graded assignment scores
#                  for that learner in that course
#
# Relationships:
#   Grade >── Submission    (one grade belongs to one submission)
#   Grade >── User          (one grade awarded by one admin)
#
# Grading Lifecycle:
#   Admin opens submission in grading interface
#       → Admin reviews text content and/or downloads file
#       → Admin enters score_awarded and written feedback
#       → Admin optionally fills in rubric_scores breakdown
#       → Admin clicks Save Grade
#       → Grade record created
#       → Submission.mark_graded(score_percent) called
#       → Enrollment.final_score recalculated
#       → Learner sees grade and feedback on their page
# =============================================================

from datetime import datetime
from app.extensions import db


# =============================================================
# GRADE MODEL
# =============================================================

class Grade(db.Model):
    """
    Represents the admin's evaluation of a single submission.

    One Grade record exists per Submission — enforced by the
    unique constraint on submission_id. If the admin needs
    to revise a grade, they update the existing Grade record
    rather than creating a new one.

    The score_percent field is calculated automatically
    from score_awarded and max_score when the grade is
    created or updated:
        score_percent = (score_awarded / max_score) * 100

    The is_passed field is determined by comparing
    score_percent against the assignment's pass_mark:
        is_passed = score_percent >= pass_mark_percent

    The feedback field supports free-form written comments
    from the admin to the learner, explaining what was
    done well, what needs improvement, and any suggestions
    for the learner's agricultural practice or further study.

    The rubric_scores field is an optional JSON-formatted
    text field that allows the admin to break down the
    score by individual assessment criteria — for example:
        {
            "Content Accuracy": 18,
            "Practical Application": 15,
            "Presentation": 8,
            "References": 9
        }
    """

    __tablename__ = 'grades'

    # ── Table-level constraints ───────────────────────────────
    __table_args__ = (
        # One grade per submission — enforces one-to-one
        db.UniqueConstraint(
            'submission_id',
            name='uq_grade_submission'
        ),
    )

    # ── Primary Key ───────────────────────────────────────────
    id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        primary_key=True,
        autoincrement=True,
        comment='Unique grade identifier — auto-incremented primary key'
    )

    # ── Foreign Keys ──────────────────────────────────────────
    submission_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        db.ForeignKey('submissions.id', ondelete='CASCADE'),
        nullable=False,
        unique=True,
        index=True,
        comment=(
            'Foreign key — ID of the submission being graded. '
            'UNIQUE: enforces one grade per submission. '
            'CASCADE: deleting a submission deletes its grade.'
        )
    )

    graded_by = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        db.ForeignKey('users.id', ondelete='SET NULL'),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
        comment=(
            'Foreign key — ID of the admin user who graded '
            'this submission. SET NULL if the admin is deleted.'
        )
    )

    # ── Score Fields ──────────────────────────────────────────
    score_awarded = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(6, 2),
        nullable=False,
        comment=(
            'The raw score awarded by the admin for this submission. '
            'Must be between 0 and max_score. '
            'e.g. If total_marks=100 and admin awards 75, '
            'score_awarded=75.00'
        )
    )

    max_score = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(6, 2),
        nullable=False,
        comment=(
            'The maximum possible score for this assignment — '
            'copied from Assignment.total_marks at grading time. '
            'Stored here so the grade remains accurate even if '
            'the assignment total_marks is later changed.'
        )
    )

    score_percent = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(5, 2),
        nullable=False,
        comment=(
            'The final percentage score calculated as: '
            '(score_awarded / max_score) * 100. '
            'Calculated and stored at grading time. '
            'This is the value used for enrollment final_score averaging.'
        )
    )

    # ── Pass / Fail ───────────────────────────────────────────
    is_passed = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'Pass/fail flag for this individual assignment submission. '
            'True if score_percent >= assignment.pass_mark (as percentage). '
            'Calculated at grading time.'
        )
    )

    # ── Late Penalty ──────────────────────────────────────────
    late_penalty_applied = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(5, 2),
        nullable=True,
        default=0.00,
        comment=(
            'Percentage penalty applied to this submission because '
            'it was submitted late. Copied from '
            'Assignment.late_penalty_percent when the submission '
            'is flagged as late. '
            'e.g. 10.00 means 10 percent was deducted. '
            '0.00 means no penalty was applied.'
        )
    )

    adjusted_score_percent = db.Column(
        db.Numeric(5, 2),
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'The final score_percent after applying the late penalty. '
            'adjusted_score_percent = score_percent - late_penalty_applied. '
            'If no late penalty, this equals score_percent. '
            'This is the value that flows into enrollment final_score.'
        )
    )

    # ── Feedback ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    feedback = db.Column(
        db.Text,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Written feedback from the admin to the learner. '
            'Should explain what was done well, what needs '
            'improvement, and offer constructive suggestions. '
            'Displayed to the learner on their submission page '
            'after grading is complete.'
        )
    )

    # ── Rubric Breakdown ──────────────────────────────────────
    rubric_scores = db.Column(
        db.Text,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Optional JSON-formatted text storing a criterion-by-'
            'criterion breakdown of the score. '
            'Format: {"Criterion Name": score_value, ...} '
            'e.g. {"Content Accuracy": 18, "Practical Application": 15} '
            'Displayed as a breakdown table in the grading and '
            'learner feedback views.'
        )
    )

    # ── Internal Admin Notes ──────────────────────────────────
    internal_notes = db.Column(
        db.Text,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Internal grading notes visible only to admins — '
            'not shown to the learner. Used for recording '
            'grading rationale, moderation notes, or '
            'quality assurance comments.'
        )
    )

    # ── Grade Revision Tracking ───────────────────────────────
    is_revised = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'Flag indicating whether this grade has been revised '
            'after the initial grading. True if the admin has '
            'updated the score or feedback at least once after '
            'the original grading.'
        )
    )

    revision_count = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        nullable=False,
        default=0,
        comment=(
            'Number of times this grade has been revised. '
            'Incremented each time the admin updates the grade '
            'after the initial submission.'
        )
    )

    revision_reason = db.Column(
        db.Text,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Admin explanation for why the grade was revised — '
            'e.g. marking error corrected, moderation applied, '
            'appeal granted. Visible to the learner.'
        )
    )

    # ── Notification Status ───────────────────────────────────
    learner_notified = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'Flag indicating whether the learner has been notified '
            'about this grade. Set to True after the platform '
            'displays or sends the grade notification to the learner.'
        )
    )

    # ── Timestamps ────────────────────────────────────────────
    date_graded = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=False,
        default=datetime.utcnow,
        comment='UTC timestamp of when this grade was first created by the admin.'
    )

    date_revised = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        comment='UTC timestamp of the most recent grade revision.'
    )

    date_updated = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        onupdate=datetime.utcnow,
        comment='UTC timestamp of the most recent update to this grade record.'
    )

    # ==========================================================
    # SCORE CALCULATION METHODS
    # ==========================================================

    @staticmethod
    def calculate_score_percent(score_awarded, max_score):
        """
        Calculate the percentage score from raw score values.

        Args:
            score_awarded (float): The raw score the admin awarded.
            max_score (float): The maximum possible score.

        Returns:
            float: Percentage score rounded to 2 decimal places.
                   Returns 0.0 if max_score is zero or None.

        Example:
            calculate_score_percent(75, 100) → 75.0
            calculate_score_percent(18, 25)  → 72.0
        """
        if not max_score or float(max_score) <= 0:
            return 0.0
        percent = (float(score_awarded) / float(max_score)) * 100
        return round(percent, 2)

    @staticmethod
    def calculate_adjusted_score(score_percent, late_penalty_percent):
        """
        Apply a late submission penalty to a score percentage.

        Args:
            score_percent (float): The raw percentage score.
            late_penalty_percent (float): Percentage to deduct.

        Returns:
            float: Adjusted score after penalty, minimum 0.0.

        Example:
            calculate_adjusted_score(85.0, 10.0) → 75.0
            calculate_adjusted_score(5.0, 10.0)  → 0.0
        """
        if not late_penalty_percent or float(late_penalty_percent) <= 0:
            return round(float(score_percent), 2)
        adjusted = float(score_percent) - float(late_penalty_percent)
        return round(max(adjusted, 0.0), 2)

    def compute_and_set_scores(self, pass_mark_percent=50.0):
        """
        Calculate and set score_percent, adjusted_score_percent,
        and is_passed based on the current score_awarded,
        max_score, and late_penalty_applied values.

        Should be called after setting score_awarded, max_score,
        and late_penalty_applied before saving the grade.

        Args:
            pass_mark_percent (float): The minimum percentage
                required to pass this assignment. Defaults to 50.0.

        Example:
            grade.score_awarded = 75
            grade.max_score = 100
            grade.late_penalty_applied = 10
            grade.compute_and_set_scores(pass_mark_percent=50.0)
            # score_percent = 75.0
            # adjusted_score_percent = 65.0
            # is_passed = True
        """
        self.score_percent = self.calculate_score_percent(
            self.score_awarded,
            self.max_score
        )

        penalty = float(self.late_penalty_applied) if self.late_penalty_applied else 0.0
        self.adjusted_score_percent = self.calculate_adjusted_score(
            self.score_percent,
            penalty
        )

        self.is_passed = float(self.adjusted_score_percent) >= float(pass_mark_percent)

    # ==========================================================
    # REVISION METHODS
    # ==========================================================

    def revise(self, reason=None):
        """
        Record a grade revision by incrementing the revision
        counter, setting the is_revised flag, recording the
        revision timestamp, and storing the reason.

        Args:
            reason (str, optional): The reason for revising
                                    the grade.
        """
        self.is_revised = True
        self.revision_count += 1
        self.date_revised = datetime.utcnow()
        if reason:
            self.revision_reason = reason

    def mark_learner_notified(self):
        """
        Mark that the learner has been notified about
        this grade result.
        """
        self.learner_notified = True

    # ==========================================================
    # RUBRIC HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def get_rubric_scores_dict(self):
        """
        Parse the JSON-formatted rubric_scores text field
        into a Python dictionary.

        Returns:
            dict: Criterion-to-score mapping or empty dict.
        """
        if not self.rubric_scores:
            return {}
        try:
            import json
            return json.loads(self.rubric_scores)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return {}

    def set_rubric_scores_from_dict(self, scores_dict):
        """
        Serialize a Python dictionary of rubric scores
        into JSON text for storage.

        Args:
            scores_dict (dict): Criterion-to-score mapping.
        """
        import json
        self.rubric_scores = json.dumps(scores_dict)

    def get_rubric_total(self):
        """
        Sum all criterion scores in the rubric breakdown.

        Returns:
            float: Sum of all rubric criterion scores.
        """
        rubric = self.get_rubric_scores_dict()
        if not rubric:
            return 0.0
        return sum(float(v) for v in rubric.values())

    # ==========================================================
    # DISPLAY HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def get_score_display(self):
        """
        Format the score as 'awarded / max' string.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted score string.
        """
        awarded = float(self.score_awarded) if self.score_awarded else 0.0
        maximum = float(self.max_score) if self.max_score else 0.0
        return f'{awarded:g} / {maximum:g}'

    def get_percent_display(self):
        """
        Format score_percent as a clean percentage string.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted percentage string.
        """
        if self.score_percent is None:
            return '0%'
        value = float(self.score_percent)
        if value == int(value):
            return f'{int(value)}%'
        return f'{value:.2f}%'

    def get_adjusted_percent_display(self):
        """
        Format adjusted_score_percent with penalty note.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted adjusted percentage string.
        """
        if self.adjusted_score_percent is None:
            return '0%'

        value = float(self.adjusted_score_percent)
        display = f'{int(value)}%' if value == int(value) else f'{value:.2f}%'

        penalty = float(self.late_penalty_applied) if self.late_penalty_applied else 0.0
        if penalty > 0:
            display += f' (after {penalty:g}% late penalty)'

        return display

    def get_grade_letter(self):
        """
        Convert adjusted_score_percent into a letter grade.

        Scale:
            A — 70% and above   (Distinction)
            B — 60% to 69%      (Merit)
            C — 50% to 59%      (Pass)
            D — 40% to 49%      (Below Pass)
            F — Below 40%       (Fail)

        Returns:
            str: Single letter grade.
        """
        if self.adjusted_score_percent is None:
            return 'F'

        score = float(self.adjusted_score_percent)

        if score >= 70:
            return 'A'
        elif score >= 60:
            return 'B'
        elif score >= 50:
            return 'C'
        elif score >= 40:
            return 'D'
        else:
            return 'F'

    def get_grade_label(self):
        """
        Return a descriptive label for the letter grade.

        Returns:
            str: Full grade label.
        """
        labels = {
            'A': 'Distinction',
            'B': 'Merit',
            'C': 'Pass',
            'D': 'Below Pass',
            'F': 'Fail',
        }
        return labels.get(self.get_grade_letter(), 'Fail')

    def get_grade_badge_class(self):
        """
        Return a CSS class for the grade letter badge.

        Returns:
            str: CSS badge class string.
        """
        badge_classes = {
            'A': 'badge-success',
            'B': 'badge-primary',
            'C': 'badge-info',
            'D': 'badge-warning',
            'F': 'badge-danger',
        }
        return badge_classes.get(self.get_grade_letter(), 'badge-secondary')

    def get_date_graded_display(self):
        """
        Format date_graded into a readable string.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted grading date string.
        """
        return self.date_graded.strftime('%d %B %Y at %I:%M %p UTC')

    def get_turnaround_days(self):
        """
        Calculate days between submission and grading.

        Returns:
            int or None: Turnaround days or None.
        """
        if self.submission and self.submission.date_submitted:
            delta = self.date_graded - self.submission.date_submitted
            return max(delta.days, 0)
        return None

    # ==========================================================
    # SERIALIZATION
    # ==========================================================

    def to_dict(self, include_internal_notes=False):
        """
        Serialize the Grade object to a plain dictionary.

        Args:
            include_internal_notes (bool): Include admin-only
                internal_notes field. Default False.

        Returns:
            dict: Grade data with all computed display fields.
        """
        data = {
            'id':                       self.id,
            'submission_id':            self.submission_id,
            'graded_by':                self.graded_by,
            'score_awarded':            float(self.score_awarded),
            'max_score':                float(self.max_score),
            'score_percent':            float(self.score_percent),
            'score_display':            self.get_score_display(),
            'percent_display':          self.get_percent_display(),
            'late_penalty_applied':     float(self.late_penalty_applied)
                                        if self.late_penalty_applied else 0.0,
            'adjusted_score_percent':   float(self.adjusted_score_percent)
                                        if self.adjusted_score_percent is not None
                                        else float(self.score_percent),
            'adjusted_percent_display': self.get_adjusted_percent_display(),
            'is_passed':                self.is_passed,
            'grade_letter':             self.get_grade_letter(),
            'grade_label':              self.get_grade_label(),
            'grade_badge_class':        self.get_grade_badge_class(),
            'feedback':                 self.feedback,
            'rubric_scores':            self.get_rubric_scores_dict(),
            'rubric_total':             self.get_rubric_total(),
            'is_revised':               self.is_revised,
            'revision_count':           self.revision_count,
            'revision_reason':          self.revision_reason,
            'learner_notified':         self.learner_notified,
            'turnaround_days':          self.get_turnaround_days(),
            'date_graded':              self.date_graded.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
            'date_graded_display':      self.get_date_graded_display(),
            'date_revised':             self.date_revised.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.date_revised else None,
            'date_updated':             self.date_updated.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.date_updated else None,
        }

        if include_internal_notes:
            data['internal_notes'] = self.internal_notes

        return data

    # ==========================================================
    # STRING REPRESENTATION
    # ==========================================================

    def __repr__(self):
        return (
            f'<Grade id={self.id} '
            f'submission_id={self.submission_id} '
            f'score={self.score_awarded}/{self.max_score} '
            f'({self.score_percent}%) '
            f'letter={self.get_grade_letter()} '
            f'passed={self.is_passed}>'
        )

# =============================================================
# Agri LMS — Material Model
# =============================================================
# File    : app/models/material.py
# Purpose : Defines the Material database model representing
#           every learning resource uploaded to a module.
#
#           Materials are the actual content that learners
#           consume inside a module. A single module can
#           contain multiple materials of different types.
#
#           Supported material types:
#               video    — MP4, WebM, MKV files
#                          Learners can stream online and
#                          download if allowed by admin.
#               pdf      — PDF documents
#                          Rendered in the browser viewer
#                          with optional download.
#               document — Word, PowerPoint, Excel files
#                          Downloadable only.
#               image    — PNG, JPG, GIF files
#                          Displayed inline in the module.
#               other    — ZIP, RAR, and any other files
#                          Downloadable only.
#
#           Each material has its own order number within
#           its parent module, allowing the admin to arrange
#           materials in any desired sequence.
#
# Relationships:
#   Material >── Module     (many materials belong to one module)
#
# Learning Hierarchy:
#   Course
#     └── Module
#           └── Material 1  (order_number=1, type=video)
#           └── Material 2  (order_number=2, type=pdf)
#           └── Material 3  (order_number=3, type=document)
# =============================================================

from datetime import datetime
from app.extensions import db


# =============================================================
# MATERIAL TYPE CONSTANTS
# =============================================================
# These constants define all valid material types.
# Used for validation, filtering, and display logic.

MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO    = 'video'
MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF      = 'pdf'
MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT = 'document'
MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE    = 'image'
MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER    = 'other'

MATERIAL_TYPES = [
    MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,
    MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF,
    MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,
    MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER,
]

# File extension to material type mapping
# Used by the upload handler to auto-detect material type
EXTENSION_TYPE_MAP = {
    # Video formats
    'mp4':  MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,
    'webm': MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,
    'mkv':  MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,
    'avi':  MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,
    'mov':  MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,

    # PDF
    'pdf':  MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF,

    # Document formats
    'doc':  MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    'docx': MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    'ppt':  MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    'pptx': MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    'xls':  MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    'xlsx': MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,
    'txt':  MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT,

    # Image formats
    'png':  MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,
    'jpg':  MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,
    'jpeg': MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,
    'gif':  MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,
    'webp': MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,

    # Archive and other formats
    'zip':  MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER,
    'rar':  MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER,
    '7z':   MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER,
}


# =============================================================
# MATERIAL MODEL
# =============================================================

class Material(db.Model):
    """
    Represents a single learning resource file within a Module.

    Materials are uploaded by admins and consumed by learners.
    Each material belongs to exactly one module and has an
    order number that determines its display sequence within
    that module.

    The allow_download flag gives admins control over whether
    learners can download the material to their local device,
    or only view it online through the browser.

    For videos — the platform streams them using the HTML5
    video player. If allow_download is True, a download
    button is shown below the player.

    For PDFs — the platform renders them using the browser's
    native PDF viewer embedded in an iframe. If allow_download
    is True, a download link is shown alongside the viewer.

    For documents, images, and other files — these are
    always download-only since they cannot be rendered inline.
    """

    __tablename__ = 'materials'

    # ── Table-level constraints ───────────────────────────────
    __table_args__ = (
        # Enforce unique ordering within each module
        # No two materials in the same module share an order number
        db.UniqueConstraint(
            'module_id',
            'order_number',
            name='uq_material_module_order'
        ),
    )

    # ── Primary Key ───────────────────────────────────────────
    id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        primary_key=True,
        autoincrement=True,
        comment='Unique material identifier — auto-incremented primary key'
    )

    # ── Foreign Key — Parent Module ───────────────────────────
    module_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        db.ForeignKey('modules.id', ondelete='CASCADE'),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
        comment=(
            'Foreign key — ID of the module this material belongs to. '
            'CASCADE: deleting a module deletes all its materials.'
        )
    )

    # ── Material Identity ─────────────────────────────────────
    title = db.Column(
        db.String(300),
        nullable=False,
        comment=(
            'Display title of the material shown to learners — '
            'e.g. "Introduction Video", "Week 1 Reading PDF", '
            '"Soil Testing Guide"'
        )
    )

    description = db.Column(
        db.Text,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Optional description of the material — '
            'explains what the learner will get from it'
        )
    )

    # ── Material Type ─────────────────────────────────────────
    material_type = db.Column(
        db.String(20),
        nullable=False,
        default=MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER,
        comment=(
            'Type of material — determines how it is rendered. '
            'video: streamed in HTML5 player | '
            'pdf: rendered in iframe PDF viewer | '
            'document: download only | '
            'image: displayed inline | '
            'other: download only'
        )
    )

    # ── File Information ──────────────────────────────────────
    file_name = db.Column(
        db.String(255),
        nullable=False,
        comment=(
            'Original filename as uploaded by the admin — '
            'stored for display purposes only'
        )
    )

    stored_file_name = db.Column(
        db.String(255),
        nullable=False,
        comment=(
            'Actual filename used on the server filesystem — '
            'UUID-prefixed to prevent collisions and directory traversal. '
            'File is stored in static/uploads/materials/'
        )
    )

    file_extension = db.Column(
        db.String(20),
        nullable=True,
        comment='Lowercase file extension without dot — e.g. mp4, pdf, docx'
    )

    file_size_bytes = db.Column(
        db.BigInteger,
        nullable=True,
        comment='File size in bytes — used for display and storage management'
    )

    mime_type = db.Column(
        db.String(100),
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'MIME type of the file — '
            'e.g. video/mp4, application/pdf, '
            'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
        )
    )

    # ── Sequencing ────────────────────────────────────────────
    order_number = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        nullable=False,
        default=1,
        comment=(
            'Position of this material within its module. '
            'Materials are displayed in ascending order_number sequence. '
            'Must be unique within a module — enforced by uq_material_module_order.'
        )
    )

    # ── External Content ──────────────────────────────────────
    external_url = db.Column(
        db.String(1000),
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Optional external URL for this material — '
            'used when the content is hosted externally '
            'e.g. YouTube, Google Drive, OneDrive. '
            'If set and stored_file_name is NULL, the platform '
            'links to this URL instead of a local file.'
        )
    )

    is_external = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'True if this material points to an external URL '
            'rather than a locally uploaded file'
        )
    )

    # ── Access Control ────────────────────────────────────────
    allow_download = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=True,
        comment=(
            'Download permission flag — '
            'True: learners can download this material to their device | '
            'False: learners can only view it online. '
            'For videos and PDFs this controls the download button. '
            'Documents, images, and other files are always downloadable.'
        )
    )

    # ── Video-Specific Fields ─────────────────────────────────
    video_duration_seconds = db.Column(
        db.Integer,
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Duration of a video material in seconds — '
            'used to display formatted video length to learners. '
            'Only applicable when material_type is video.'
        )
    )

    video_thumbnail = db.Column(
        db.String(255),
        nullable=True,
        comment=(
            'Filename of the video thumbnail image — '
            'displayed before the video is played. '
            'Stored in static/uploads/thumbnails/. '
            'Only applicable when material_type is video.'
        )
    )

    # ── Publishing Status ─────────────────────────────────────
    is_published = db.Column(
        db.Boolean,
        nullable=False,
        default=False,
        comment=(
            'Publication flag — '
            'False: material is a draft visible only to admins | '
            'True: material is visible to enrolled learners'
        )
    )

    # ── Timestamps ────────────────────────────────────────────
    date_uploaded = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=False,
        default=datetime.utcnow,
        comment='UTC timestamp of when this material was uploaded by the admin'
    )

    date_updated = db.Column(
        db.DateTime,
        nullable=True,
        onupdate=datetime.utcnow,
        comment='UTC timestamp of the most recent update to this material record'
    )

    # ==========================================================
    # FILE SIZE HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def get_file_size_display(self):
        """
        Convert raw file_size_bytes into a human-readable
        string with appropriate unit.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted file size string.

        Examples:
            500        → '500 B'
            15360      → '15.0 KB'
            2097152    → '2.0 MB'
            1073741824 → '1.0 GB'
        """
        if not self.file_size_bytes:
            return 'Unknown size'

        size = self.file_size_bytes

        if size < 1024:
            return f'{size} B'
        elif size < 1024 ** 2:
            return f'{size / 1024:.1f} KB'
        elif size < 1024 ** 3:
            return f'{size / (1024 ** 2):.1f} MB'
        else:
            return f'{size / (1024 ** 3):.1f} GB'

    # ==========================================================
    # VIDEO DURATION HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def get_video_duration_display(self):
        """
        Convert video_duration_seconds into a human-readable
        hours:minutes:seconds string.

        Returns:
            str: Formatted duration string or 'N/A' if not set.

        Examples:
            45    → '0:45'
            90    → '1:30'
            3661  → '1:01:01'
        """
        if not self.video_duration_seconds:
            return 'N/A'

        total = self.video_duration_seconds
        hours = total // 3600
        minutes = (total % 3600) // 60
        seconds = total % 60

        if hours > 0:
            return f'{hours}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}'
        else:
            return f'{minutes}:{seconds:02d}'

    # ==========================================================
    # FILE PATH HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def get_file_url(self):
        """
        Build the URL path for accessing this material's file
        through the Flask static file serving route.

        Returns:
            str: Relative URL path to the material file.
                 Returns the external_url if is_external is True.
                 Returns None if neither file nor URL is available.

        Examples:
            Local  → 'uploads/materials/uuid_filename.mp4'
            External → 'https://youtu.be/example'
        """
        if self.is_external and self.external_url:
            return self.external_url
        if self.stored_file_name:
            return f'uploads/materials/{self.stored_file_name}'
        return None

    def get_video_thumbnail_url(self):
        """
        Build the URL path for accessing the video thumbnail
        image through the Flask static file serving route.

        Returns:
            str or None: Relative URL path to the thumbnail,
                         or None if no thumbnail is set.
        """
        if self.video_thumbnail:
            return f'uploads/thumbnails/{self.video_thumbnail}'
        return None

    # ==========================================================
    # TYPE DETECTION HELPERS
    # ==========================================================

    def is_video(self):
        """
        Check whether this material is a video.

        Returns:
            bool: True if material_type is 'video'.
        """
        return self.material_type == MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO

    def is_pdf(self):
        """
        Check whether this material is a PDF document.

        Returns:
            bool: True if material_type is 'pdf'.
        """
        return self.material_type == MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF

    def is_document(self):
        """
        Check whether this material is an office document.

        Returns:
            bool: True if material_type is 'document'.
        """
        return self.material_type == MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT

    def is_image(self):
        """
        Check whether this material is an image.

        Returns:
            bool: True if material_type is 'image'.
        """
        return self.material_type == MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE

    def is_viewable_online(self):
        """
        Determine whether this material can be viewed
        directly in the browser without downloading.

        Videos and PDFs are viewable online.
        Documents, images uploaded as type 'other', and
        archives require downloading.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the material renders inline.
        """
        return self.material_type in (
            MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO,
            MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF,
            MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE,
        )

    def get_type_icon(self):
        """
        Return an emoji or icon identifier corresponding
        to the material type for use in templates.

        Returns:
            str: Icon string for the material type.
        """
        icons = {
            MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO:    '🎬',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF:      '📄',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT: '📝',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE:    '🖼️',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER:    '📦',
        }
        return icons.get(self.material_type, '📁')

    def get_type_label(self):
        """
        Return a human-readable label for the material type.

        Returns:
            str: Capitalized type label.
        """
        labels = {
            MATERIAL_TYPE_VIDEO:    'Video',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_PDF:      'PDF Document',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_DOCUMENT: 'Document',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_IMAGE:    'Image',
            MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER:    'File',
        }
        return labels.get(self.material_type, 'File')

    # ==========================================================
    # STATIC UTILITY METHODS
    # ==========================================================

    @staticmethod
    def detect_type_from_extension(extension):
        """
        Detect and return the material type string based on
        a file extension using the EXTENSION_TYPE_MAP.

        Args:
            extension (str): Lowercase file extension without
                             the leading dot — e.g. 'mp4', 'pdf'

        Returns:
            str: Corresponding material type constant string.
                 Returns MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER if not recognized.

        Example:
            Material.detect_type_from_extension('mp4') → 'video'
            Material.detect_type_from_extension('pdf') → 'pdf'
            Material.detect_type_from_extension('xyz') → 'other'
        """
        return EXTENSION_TYPE_MAP.get(
            extension.lower().strip(),
            MATERIAL_TYPE_OTHER
        )

    @staticmethod
    def generate_stored_filename(original_filename):
        """
        Generate a unique server-side filename for a newly
        uploaded file by prepending a UUID4 to the original
        filename. This prevents filename collisions and
        eliminates directory traversal vulnerabilities.

        Args:
            original_filename (str): The original filename
                                     as provided by the uploader.

        Returns:
            str: UUID-prefixed safe filename.

        Example:
            'soil guide.pdf' → 'a3f1c2d4_soil_guide.pdf'
        """
        import uuid
        import re

        # Sanitize — replace spaces and special characters
        safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.]', '_', original_filename)
        unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
        return f'{unique_id}_{safe_name}'

    # ==========================================================
    # SERIALIZATION
    # ==========================================================

    def to_dict(self):
        """
        Serialize the Material object to a plain dictionary
        suitable for JSON responses and template rendering.

        Returns:
            dict: Material data with all computed fields included.
        """
        return {
            'id':                       self.id,
            'module_id':                self.module_id,
            'title':                    self.title,
            'description':              self.description,
            'material_type':            self.material_type,
            'type_label':               self.get_type_label(),
            'type_icon':                self.get_type_icon(),
            'file_name':                self.file_name,
            'stored_file_name':         self.stored_file_name,
            'file_extension':           self.file_extension,
            'file_size_bytes':          self.file_size_bytes,
            'file_size_display':        self.get_file_size_display(),
            'mime_type':                self.mime_type,
            'order_number':             self.order_number,
            'external_url':             self.external_url,
            'is_external':              self.is_external,
            'allow_download':           self.allow_download,
            'video_duration_seconds':   self.video_duration_seconds,
            'video_duration_display':   self.get_video_duration_display(),
            'video_thumbnail':          self.video_thumbnail,
            'video_thumbnail_url':      self.get_video_thumbnail_url(),
            'file_url':                 self.get_file_url(),
            'is_viewable_online':       self.is_viewable_online(),
            'is_video':                 self.is_video(),
            'is_pdf':                   self.is_pdf(),
            'is_document':              self.is_document(),
            'is_image':                 self.is_image(),
            'is_published':             self.is_published,
            'date_uploaded':            self.date_uploaded.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
            'date_updated':             self.date_updated.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                                        if self.date_updated else None,
        }

    # ==========================================================
    # STRING REPRESENTATION
    # ==========================================================

    def __repr__(self):
        return (
            f'<Material id={self.id} '
            f'module_id={self.module_id} '
            f'type={self.material_type!r} '
            f'title={self.title!r}>'
        )
