/**
 * Create a line chart with the platform's green theme.
 * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas - Target canvas element
 * @param {string[]} labels - X-axis labels
 * @param {number[]} data - Data points
 * @param {string} [label='Data'] - Dataset label
 * @returns {Chart} Chart.js instance
 */
function createLineChart(canvas, labels, data, label) {
    if (!canvas || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return null;

    return new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [{
                label: label || 'Data',
                data: data,
                borderColor:     AgriLMS.colors.green,
                backgroundColor: function(context) {
                    const chart = context.chart;
                    const { ctx, chartArea } = chart;
                    if (!chartArea) return 'rgba(45,106,79,0.1)';
                    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(
                        0, chartArea.top, 0, chartArea.bottom
                    );
                    gradient.addColorStop(0,   'rgba(45,106,79,0.3)');
                    gradient.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(45,106,79,0.02)');
                    return gradient;
                },
                borderWidth:         2.5,
                pointBackgroundColor: AgriLMS.colors.green,
                pointBorderColor:     '#ffffff',
                pointBorderWidth:     2,
                pointRadius:          5,
                pointHoverRadius:     7,
                fill:    true,
                tension: 0.4,
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive:          true,
            maintainAspectRatio: true,
            interaction: {
                mode:      'index',
                intersect: false,
            },
            plugins: {
                legend: { display: false },
            },
            scales: {
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    ticks: {
                        precision: 0,
                        color:     AgriLMS.colors.gray,
                    },
                    grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' },
                },
                x: {
                    ticks: {
                        color: AgriLMS.colors.gray,
                        font:  { weight: '600' },
                    },
                    grid: { display: false },
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

/**
 * Create a bar chart with the platform's color palette.
 * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas - Target canvas element
 * @param {string[]} labels - X-axis labels
 * @param {number[]} data - Data values
 * @param {string} [color] - Bar color (defaults to green)
 * @param {string} [label='Data'] - Dataset label
 * @returns {Chart} Chart.js instance
 */
function createBarChart(canvas, labels, data, color, label) {
    if (!canvas || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return null;

    const barColor = color || AgriLMS.colors.green;

    return new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [{
                label: label || 'Data',
                data: data,
                backgroundColor: barColor.replace(')', ', 0.8)').replace('rgb', 'rgba'),
                borderColor:     barColor,
                borderWidth:     2,
                borderRadius:    6,
                borderSkipped:   false,
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive:          true,
            maintainAspectRatio: true,
            plugins: {
                legend: { display: false },
            },
            scales: {
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    ticks: {
                        precision: 0,
                        color:     AgriLMS.colors.gray,
                    },
                    grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' },
                },
                x: {
                    ticks: { color: AgriLMS.colors.gray },
                    grid:  { display: false },
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

/**
 * Create a doughnut chart with center text label.
 * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas - Target canvas element
 * @param {string[]} labels - Segment labels
 * @param {number[]} data - Segment values
 * @param {string} centerText - Text to display in center
 * @param {string} centerSub - Sub-text below center text
 * @returns {Chart} Chart.js instance
 */
function createDoughnutChart(canvas, labels, data, centerText, centerSub) {
    if (!canvas || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return null;

    return new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [{
                data: data,
                backgroundColor: AgriLMS.chartColors.primary.slice(0, data.length),
                borderColor:     AgriLMS.chartColors.borders.slice(0, data.length),
                borderWidth:     2,
                borderRadius:    4,
                hoverOffset:     6,
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive:          true,
            maintainAspectRatio: true,
            cutout:              '68%',
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    display:  true,
                    position: 'bottom',
                    labels: {
                        padding:        16,
                        usePointStyle:  true,
                        pointStyleWidth: 10,
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        plugins: [{
            id: 'centerText',
            afterDraw: function(chart) {
                if (!centerText) return;
                const { ctx, chartArea } = chart;
                if (!chartArea) return;

                const cx = (chartArea.left + chartArea.right) / 2;
                const cy = (chartArea.top + chartArea.bottom) / 2;

                ctx.save();
                ctx.font         = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                ctx.fillStyle    = AgriLMS.colors.greenDark;
                ctx.textAlign    = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText(centerText, cx, cy - (centerSub ? 8 : 0));

                if (centerSub) {
                    ctx.font      = '11px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                    ctx.fillStyle = AgriLMS.colors.gray;
                    ctx.fillText(centerSub, cx, cy + 12);
                }

                ctx.restore();
            }
        }]
    });
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 5 — TABLE ENHANCEMENTS
   Enhanced sorting, filtering, and export for data tables.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Initialize sortable column headers on a table.
 * Clicking a column header sorts the table by that column.
 * Clicking again reverses the sort order.
 * @param {HTMLTableElement} table - The table to make sortable
 */
function initSortableTable(table) {
    if (!table) return;

    const headers = $$('thead th.sortable', table);

    headers.forEach(function(th, colIndex) {
        th.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        th.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        th.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

        let ascending = true;

        function sort() {
            const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
            if (!tbody) return;

            const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'));

            rows.sort(function(a, b) {
                const aText = (a.cells[colIndex] || {}).textContent || '';
                const bText = (b.cells[colIndex] || {}).textContent || '';

                /* Try numeric sort first */
                const aNum = parseFloat(aText.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));
                const bNum = parseFloat(bText.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));

                if (!isNaN(aNum) && !isNaN(bNum)) {
                    return ascending ? aNum - bNum : bNum - aNum;
                }

                /* Fall back to string sort */
                return ascending
                    ? aText.localeCompare(bText)
                    : bText.localeCompare(aText);
            });

            /* Clear sort indicators */
            headers.forEach(function(h) {
                h.classList.remove('sort-asc', 'sort-desc');
            });

            /* Apply sort indicator */
            th.classList.add(ascending ? 'sort-asc' : 'sort-desc');
            ascending = !ascending;

            /* Re-append sorted rows */
            rows.forEach(function(row) {
                tbody.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        th.addEventListener('click', sort);
        th.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                sort();
            }
        });
    });
}

/**
 * Export a table's data as a CSV file download.
 * @param {HTMLTableElement} table - The table to export
 * @param {string} [filename='export.csv'] - Download filename
 */
function exportTableToCSV(table, filename) {
    if (!table) return;

    const rows  = $$('tr', table);
    const lines = rows.map(function(row) {
        return $$('th, td', row).map(function(cell) {
            /* Clean cell text and wrap in quotes */
            const text = cell.textContent.trim()
                .replace(/"/g, '""')
                .replace(/\n/g, ' ');
            return '"' + text + '"';
        }).join(',');
    });

    const csvContent = lines.join('\n');
    const blob       = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url        = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link       = createElement('a', {
        href:     url,
        download: filename || 'export.csv',
    });

    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 6 — NOTIFICATION SYSTEM
   Enhanced toast notification management.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Display a toast notification with optional action button.
 * Extends the base showToast() defined in base.html.
 *
 * @param {string} message - Notification message
 * @param {string} [type='info'] - Type: success|info|warning|danger
 * @param {number} [duration=5000] - Auto-dismiss delay in ms
 * @param {Object} [action] - Optional action button
 * @param {string} action.label - Button text
 * @param {Function} action.onClick - Button click handler
 */
function notify(message, type, duration, action) {
    type     = type     || 'info';
    duration = duration || 5000;

    const icons = {
        success: '✅',
        info:    'ℹ️',
        warning: '⚠️',
        danger:  '❌',
    };

    const container = document.getElementById('flashContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    const toast = createElement('div', {
        class:              'alert alert-' + type + ' flash-message',
        role:               'alert',
        'data-auto-dismiss': String(duration),
    });

    let actionHTML = '';
    if (action && action.label) {
        actionHTML =
            '<button type="button" ' +
            'class="btn btn-sm btn-light" ' +
            'id="toastActionBtn" ' +
            'style="margin-left:0.5rem;flex-shrink:0;">' +
            action.label +
            '</button>';
    }

    toast.innerHTML =
        '<span class="alert-icon" aria-hidden="true">' +
            (icons[type] || 'ℹ️') +
        '</span>' +
        '<div class="alert-content" style="flex:1;">' +
            '<p class="alert-text" style="margin:0;">' +
                message +
            '</p>' +
        '</div>' +
        actionHTML +
        '<button class="alert-close" ' +
                'aria-label="Close" ' +
                'onclick="dismissFlash(this.closest(\'.flash-message\'))">' +
            '✕' +
        '</button>';

    /* Attach action handler if provided */
    if (action && action.onClick) {
        const btn = toast.querySelector('#toastActionBtn');
        if (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                action.onClick();
                dismissFlash(toast);
            });
        }
    }

    container.appendChild(toast);

    /* Auto-dismiss */
    setTimeout(function() {
        if (typeof dismissFlash === 'function') {
            dismissFlash(toast);
        }
    }, duration);

    return toast;
}

/**
 * Show a success notification.
 * @param {string} message - Success message
 */
function notifySuccess(message) {
    notify(message, 'success', 5000);
}

/**
 * Show an error notification.
 * @param {string} message - Error message
 */
function notifyError(message) {
    notify(message, 'danger', 8000);
}

/**
 * Show a warning notification.
 * @param {string} message - Warning message
 */
function notifyWarning(message) {
    notify(message, 'warning', 6000);
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 7 — PROGRESS BAR HELPERS
   Utilities for animating and updating progress bars.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Animate a progress bar to a target percentage value.
 * @param {Element} barEl - The .progress-bar element
 * @param {number} targetPercent - Target width percentage (0-100)
 * @param {number} [duration=800] - Animation duration in ms
 */
function animateProgressBar(barEl, targetPercent, duration) {
    if (!barEl) return;

    duration = duration || 800;
    const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(targetPercent || 0, 0), 100);

    barEl.style.transition = 'width ' + duration + 'ms ease';
    barEl.style.width      = clamped + '%';

    /* Auto-color based on value */
    if (barEl.classList.contains('bar-auto-color')) {
        if (clamped >= 70) {
            barEl.style.background = AgriLMS.colors.green;
        } else if (clamped >= 40) {
            barEl.style.background = AgriLMS.colors.gold;
        } else {
            barEl.style.background = AgriLMS.colors.red;
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Update all progress bars on the page that have
 * a data-value attribute, animating them from 0
 * to their target values with staggered timing.
 */
function animateAllProgressBars() {
    $$('.progress-bar[data-value]').forEach(function(bar, index) {
        const value = parseFloat(bar.dataset.value) || 0;
        bar.style.width = '0%';

        setTimeout(function() {
            animateProgressBar(bar, value);
        }, 100 + (index * 50));
    });
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 8 — FILE HANDLING UTILITIES
   Client-side file validation and preview generation.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Format a byte count as a human-readable file size string.
 * @param {number} bytes - File size in bytes
 * @returns {string} Formatted size string
 */
function formatFileSize(bytes) {
    if (!bytes || bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    const k     = 1024;
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i     = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1)) +
           ' ' + sizes[i];
}

/**
 * Get the appropriate emoji icon for a file type.
 * @param {string} filename - The filename with extension
 * @returns {string} Emoji icon character
 */
function getFileIcon(filename) {
    if (!filename) return '📁';
    const ext = filename.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
    const icons = {
        pdf:  '📄',
        doc:  '📝', docx: '📝',
        ppt:  '📊', pptx: '📊',
        xls:  '📈', xlsx: '📈',
        mp4:  '🎬', webm: '🎬', mkv: '🎬',
        png:  '🖼️', jpg:  '🖼️', jpeg: '🖼️', gif: '🖼️',
        zip:  '📦', rar:  '📦',
        txt:  '📋',
        py:   '🐍',
        csv:  '📊',
    };
    return icons[ext] || '📁';
}

/**
 * Generate an HTML preview card for a selected file.
 * @param {File} file - The File object
 * @returns {string} HTML string for the preview card
 */
function generateFilePreviewHTML(file) {
    const icon    = getFileIcon(file.name);
    const sizeStr = formatFileSize(file.size);

    return (
        '<div class="file-preview">' +
            '<span class="file-preview-icon">' + icon + '</span>' +
            '<div class="file-preview-info">' +
                '<div class="file-preview-name" title="' + file.name + '">' +
                    file.name +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="file-preview-size">' + sizeStr + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button type="button" class="file-preview-remove" ' +
                    'onclick="clearFileInput(this)" ' +
                    'aria-label="Remove file">✕</button>' +
        '</div>'
    );
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 9 — DATE AND TIME UTILITIES
   Helper functions for date formatting and calculation.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Format a Date object as a human-readable relative string.
 * @param {Date} date - The date to format
 * @returns {string} Relative time string
 * @example
 *   relativeTime(new Date()) → 'Just now'
 *   relativeTime(yesterday)  → '1 day ago'
 */
function relativeTime(date) {
    if (!date) return 'Unknown';

    const now   = new Date();
    const delta = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000); /* seconds */

    if (delta < 60)     return 'Just now';
    if (delta < 3600)   return Math.floor(delta / 60) + ' min ago';
    if (delta < 86400)  return Math.floor(delta / 3600) + ' hr ago';
    if (delta < 604800) return Math.floor(delta / 86400) + ' day' +
                               (Math.floor(delta / 86400) !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' ago';

    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
        day:   '2-digit',
        month: 'short',
        year:  'numeric',
    });
}

/**
 * Format seconds as a MM:SS or HH:MM:SS duration string.
 * @param {number} totalSeconds - Duration in seconds
 * @returns {string} Formatted duration string
 */
function formatDuration(totalSeconds) {
    if (!totalSeconds || totalSeconds < 0) return '0:00';

    const hours   = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

    if (hours > 0) {
        return hours + ':' +
            String(minutes).padStart(2, '0') + ':' +
            String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
    }
    return minutes + ':' + String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
}

/**
 * Calculate the number of days between two dates.
 * @param {Date} dateA - Start date
 * @param {Date} dateB - End date (defaults to today)
 * @returns {number} Absolute number of days difference
 */
function daysBetween(dateA, dateB) {
    const a    = new Date(dateA);
    const b    = dateB ? new Date(dateB) : new Date();
    const diff = Math.abs(b - a);
    return Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}

/**
 * Return a human-readable label for a Nigerian growing season.
 * @param {number} month - Month number (1-12)
 * @returns {Object} {season: string, label: string, icon: string}
 */
function getGrowingSeason(month) {
    /* Nigeria growing seasons */
    if (month >= 3 && month <= 7) {
        return {
            season: 'wet_1',
            label:  'First Rainy Season (Mar–Jul)',
            icon:   '🌧️'
        };
    } else if (month >= 8 && month <= 11) {
        return {
            season: 'wet_2',
            label:  'Second Rainy Season (Aug–Nov)',
            icon:   '🌦️'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            season: 'dry',
            label:  'Dry Season (Nov–Feb)',
            icon:   '☀️'
        };
    }
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 11 — ACCESSIBILITY ENHANCEMENTS
   Keyboard navigation and screen reader improvements.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Trap keyboard focus inside a modal or dialog element.
 * Ensures Tab and Shift+Tab cycle only within the element.
 * @param {Element} container - The modal or dialog container
 * @returns {Function} Cleanup function to remove the trap
 */
function trapFocus(container) {
    if (!container) return function() {};

    const focusableSelectors = [
        'a[href]',
        'button:not([disabled])',
        'input:not([disabled])',
        'select:not([disabled])',
        'textarea:not([disabled])',
        '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
    ].join(', ');

    function getFocusable() {
        return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors))
            .filter(function(el) {
                return !el.closest('[hidden]') &&
                       window.getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none';
            });
    }

    function handler(e) {
        if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;

        const focusable = getFocusable();
        if (!focusable.length) return;

        const first = focusable[0];
        const last  = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

        if (e.shiftKey) {
            if (document.activeElement === first) {
                e.preventDefault();
                last.focus();
            }
        } else {
            if (document.activeElement === last) {
                e.preventDefault();
                first.focus();
            }
        }
    }

    container.addEventListener('keydown', handler);

    /* Return cleanup function */
    return function() {
        container.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
    };
}

/**
 * Announce a message to screen readers using an ARIA
 * live region. The message is removed after 3 seconds.
 * @param {string} message - The message to announce
 * @param {string} [politeness='polite'] - 'polite' or 'assertive'
 */
function announceToScreenReader(message, politeness) {
    const live = createElement('div', {
        'aria-live':   politeness || 'polite',
        'aria-atomic': 'true',
        style: 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;' +
               'padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;' +
               'clip:rect(0,0,0,0);border:0;',
    });

    live.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(live);

    setTimeout(function() {
        if (live.parentNode) live.parentNode.removeChild(live);
    }, 3000);
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 12 — PERFORMANCE UTILITIES
   Optimization helpers for smooth UI interactions.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Debounce a function — delays execution until after
 * the specified wait time has passed since the last call.
 * @param {Function} func - Function to debounce
 * @param {number} [wait=300] - Wait time in milliseconds
 * @returns {Function} Debounced function
 */
function debounce(func, wait) {
    let timeout;
    return function debounced() {
        const ctx  = this;
        const args = arguments;
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        timeout = setTimeout(function() {
            func.apply(ctx, args);
        }, wait || 300);
    };
}

/**
 * Throttle a function — limits execution to at most
 * once per specified time interval.
 * @param {Function} func - Function to throttle
 * @param {number} [limit=100] - Minimum interval in ms
 * @returns {Function} Throttled function
 */
function throttle(func, limit) {
    let lastCall = 0;
    return function throttled() {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastCall >= (limit || 100)) {
            lastCall = now;
            func.apply(this, arguments);
        }
    };
}

/**
 * Use IntersectionObserver to lazily initialize a component
 * only when it enters the viewport.
 * @param {Element} el - Element to observe
 * @param {Function} callback - Initialization function
 * @param {number} [threshold=0.1] - Intersection threshold
 */
function lazyInit(el, callback, threshold) {
    if (!el) return;

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
            function(entries, obs) {
                entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        callback(entry.target);
                        obs.unobserve(entry.target);
                    }
                });
            },
            { threshold: threshold || 0.1 }
        );
        observer.observe(el);
    } else {
        /* Fallback for browsers without IntersectionObserver */
        callback(el);
    }
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 13 — API REQUEST HELPERS
   Lightweight fetch wrappers for AJAX interactions.
   ============================================================= */

/**
 * Get the CSRF token from a hidden input on the page.
 * @returns {string} CSRF token value
 */
function getCsrfToken() {
    const input = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]');
    return input ? input.value : '';
}

/**
 * Make a POST request with form data and CSRF token.
 * @param {string} url - Request URL
 * @param {Object} data - Key-value data to send
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Parsed JSON response
 */
function postData(url, data) {
    const formData = new FormData();

    /* Add CSRF token */
    formData.append('csrf_token', getCsrfToken());

    /* Add provided data */
    if (data) {
        Object.keys(data).forEach(function(key) {
            formData.append(key, data[key]);
        });
    }

    return fetch(url, {
        method:  'POST',
        body:    formData,
    })
    .then(function(response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Request failed: ' + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
    });
}

/**
 * Make a GET request and return parsed JSON.
 * @param {string} url - Request URL
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Parsed JSON response
 */
function getData(url) {
    return fetch(url, {
        method:  'GET',
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
    })
    .then(function(response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error('Request failed: ' + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
    });
}


/* =============================================================
   SECTION 14 — PAGE-SPECIFIC INITIALIZERS
   Automatic initialization of enhanced features
   based on page content detection.
   ============================================================= */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    /* ── Animate all progress bars ───────────────────────── */
    animateAllProgressBars();

    /* ── Initialize sortable tables ─────────────────────── */
    $$('table.table-sortable').forEach(function(table) {
        initSortableTable(table);
    });

    /* ── CSV export buttons ───────────────────────────────── */
    $$('[data-export-table]').forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const tableId = this.dataset.exportTable;
            const table   = document.getElementById(tableId);
            const filename = this.dataset.filename || 'export.csv';
            exportTableToCSV(table, filename);
        });
    });

    /* ── Lazy-load charts ─────────────────────────────────── */
    $$('[data-lazy-chart]').forEach(function(canvas) {
        lazyInit(canvas, function(el) {
            const chartType = el.dataset.lazyChart;
            const labels    = JSON.parse(el.dataset.labels || '[]');
            const data      = JSON.parse(el.dataset.values || '[]');
            const label     = el.dataset.label || 'Data';

            if (chartType === 'line') {
                createLineChart(el, labels, data, label);
            } else if (chartType === 'bar') {
                createBarChart(el, labels, data, null, label);
            }
        });
    });

    /* ── Smooth scroll for all anchor links ──────────────── */
    $$('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(anchor) {
        anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const target = document.querySelector(
                this.getAttribute('href')
            );
            if (!target) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        });
    });

    /* ── Tooltip enhancement for data-tooltip elements ───── */
    $$('[data-tooltip]').forEach(function(el) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('title')) {
            el.setAttribute('title', el.dataset.tooltip);
        }
    });

    /* ── Auto-resize textareas ───────────────────────────── */
    $$('textarea[data-autoresize]').forEach(function(textarea) {
        function resize() {
            textarea.style.height = 'auto';
            textarea.style.height = textarea.scrollHeight + 'px';
        }
        textarea.addEventListener('input', resize);
        resize();
    });

    /* ── Back to top button ───────────────────────────────── */
    const backToTop = document.getElementById('backToTop');
    if (backToTop) {
        window.addEventListener('scroll', throttle(function() {
            backToTop.style.display =
                window.scrollY > 400 ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }, 100));

        backToTop.addEventListener('click', function() {
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
    }

    /* ── Input group prefix click focuses the input ──────── */
    $$('.input-group-prefix, .input-group-suffix').forEach(function(el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const input = this.parentNode.querySelector(
                'input, textarea, select'
            );
            if (input) input.focus();
        });
    });

});

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* ── About page feature card hover ───────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.feature-about-card').forEach(function(card) {
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.transform   = 'translateY(-5px)';
        this.style.boxShadow   = 'var(--shadow-xl)';
        this.style.borderColor = 'var(--green-pale)';
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.transform   = '';
        this.style.boxShadow   = '';
        this.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-border)';
    });
});

/* ── Responsive grids ────────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    function adjustGrids() {
        const cols = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? '1fr' : '1fr 1fr';
        ['missionGrid', 'objectivesGrid'].forEach(function(id) {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.style.gridTemplateColumns = cols;
        });
    }
    adjustGrids();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjustGrids);
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
'use strict';

/* ── 1. PAGE LOADING BAR ─────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const bar = document.getElementById('page-loading-bar');
    if (!bar) return;

    bar.style.width = '70%';

    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
        bar.style.width = '100%';
        setTimeout(function() {
            bar.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(function() { bar.style.display = 'none'; }, 300);
        }, 300);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const link = e.target.closest('a[href]');
        if (!link) return;
        const href = link.getAttribute('href');
        if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('mailto:') ||
            href.startsWith('tel:') || link.target === '_blank') return;

        bar.style.display  = 'block';
        bar.style.opacity  = '1';
        bar.style.width    = '0%';
        setTimeout(function() { bar.style.width = '60%'; }, 10);
    });
})();


/* ── 2. SIDEBAR TOGGLE ───────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const sidebar        = document.getElementById('appSidebar');
    const sidebarToggle  = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
    const sidebarOverlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');

    if (!sidebar) return;

    const COLLAPSED_KEY = 'agrilms_sidebar_collapsed';
    const isMobile = () => window.innerWidth <= 991;

    if (!isMobile() && localStorage.getItem(COLLAPSED_KEY) === 'true') {
        sidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
    }

    if (sidebarToggle) {
        sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (isMobile()) {
                sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
                if (sidebarOverlay) sidebarOverlay.classList.toggle('active');
                const isOpen = sidebar.classList.contains('mobile-open');
                sidebarToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
            } else {
                sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
                const isCollapsed = sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed');
                localStorage.setItem(COLLAPSED_KEY, isCollapsed);
                sidebarToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isCollapsed);
            }
        });
    }

    if (sidebarOverlay) {
        sidebarOverlay.addEventListener('click', function() {
            sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
            sidebarOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            if (sidebarToggle) sidebarToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        if (!isMobile()) {
            sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
            if (sidebarOverlay) sidebarOverlay.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });
})();


/* ── 3. USER DROPDOWN MENU ───────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const container = document.getElementById('userMenuContainer');
    const toggle    = document.getElementById('userMenuToggle');
    const dropdown  = document.getElementById('userDropdown');

    if (!container || !toggle || !dropdown) return;

    toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const isOpen = container.classList.toggle('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!container.contains(e.target)) {
            container.classList.remove('open');
            toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && container.classList.contains('open')) {
            container.classList.remove('open');
            toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            toggle.focus();
        }
    });
})();


/* ── 4. MOBILE HAMBURGER ─────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('mobileMenuToggle');
    if (!hamburger) return;

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
        const isOpen = hamburger.classList.contains('open');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);

        const sidebar = document.getElementById('appSidebar');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
        if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open', isOpen);
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
    });
})();


/* ── 5. FLASH MESSAGE DISMISS ────────────────────────────── */
function dismissFlash(el) {
    if (!el || el.classList.contains('dismissing')) return;
    el.classList.add('dismissing');
    setTimeout(function() {
        if (el && el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
    }, 350);
}

(function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.flash-message[data-auto-dismiss]')
        .forEach(function(flash) {
            const delay = parseInt(flash.dataset.autoDismiss, 10) || 6000;
            setTimeout(function() { dismissFlash(flash); }, delay);
        });
})();


/* ── 6. MODAL SYSTEM ─────────────────────────────────────── */
function openModal(modalId) {
    const backdrop = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (!backdrop) return;
    backdrop.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    setTimeout(function() {
        const focusable = backdrop.querySelector(
            'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
        );
        if (focusable) focusable.focus();
    }, 100);
}

function closeModal(modalId) {
    const backdrop = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (!backdrop) return;
    backdrop.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target.classList.contains('modal-backdrop')) {
        e.target.classList.remove('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const openBackdrop = document.querySelector('.modal-backdrop.active');
        if (openBackdrop) {
            openBackdrop.classList.remove('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
    }
});


/* ── 7. CONFIRMATION DIALOGS ─────────────────────────────── */
function confirmAction(message, onConfirm) {
    if (window.confirm(message || 'Are you sure?')) {
        if (typeof onConfirm === 'function') onConfirm();
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    const el = e.target.closest('[data-confirm]');
    if (!el) return;
    const message = el.dataset.confirm || 'Are you sure you want to do this?';
    if (!window.confirm(message)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
    }
});


/* ── 8. LOGOUT CONFIRMATION ──────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#logoutLink, #sidebarLogout')
        .forEach(function(link) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const href = this.getAttribute('href');
                if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to log out of {{ app_name }}?')) {
                    window.location.href = href;
                }
            });
        });
})();


/* ── 9. CHARACTER COUNTER ────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-max-chars]').forEach(function(input) {
        const max     = parseInt(input.dataset.maxChars, 10);
        const counter = input.parentNode.querySelector('.char-counter');
        if (!counter) return;

        function update() {
            const remaining = max - input.value.length;
            counter.textContent = remaining + ' characters remaining';
            counter.classList.remove('near-limit', 'at-limit');
            if (remaining <= 0)           counter.classList.add('at-limit');
            else if (remaining <= max * 0.1) counter.classList.add('near-limit');
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', update);
        update();
    });
})();


/* ── 10. FILE UPLOAD DRAG AND DROP ───────────────────────── */
(function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.file-upload-area').forEach(function(area) {
        const input   = area.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
        const preview = area.dataset.previewTarget
            ? document.getElementById(area.dataset.previewTarget) : null;

        if (!input) return;

        area.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            area.classList.add('drag-over');
        });

        area.addEventListener('dragleave', function() {
            area.classList.remove('drag-over');
        });

        area.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            area.classList.remove('drag-over');
            if (e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
                input.files = e.dataTransfer.files;
                input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            }
        });

        input.addEventListener('change', function() {
            if (!preview || !this.files || this.files.length === 0) return;
            const file   = this.files[0];
            const icons  = { video:'🎬', application:'📝', image:'🖼️', text:'📋' };
            const icon   = icons[file.type.split('/')[0]] || '📁';
            const sizeStr = file.size < 1024 * 1024
                ? (file.size / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB'
                : (file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + ' MB';

            preview.innerHTML =
                '<div class="file-preview">' +
                    '<span class="file-preview-icon">' + icon + '</span>' +
                    '<div class="file-preview-info">' +
                        '<div class="file-preview-name">' + file.name + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="file-preview-size">' + sizeStr + '</div>' +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<button type="button" class="file-preview-remove" ' +
                            'onclick="clearFileInput(this)">✕</button>' +
                '</div>';
        });
    });
})();

function clearFileInput(btn) {
    const preview = btn.closest('.file-preview');
    if (preview) preview.remove();
    const input = document.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
    if (input) input.value = '';
}


/* ── 11. PROGRESS BAR ANIMATION ──────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    function animate() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.progress-bar[data-value]')
            .forEach(function(bar) {
                const value = Math.min(Math.max(parseFloat(bar.dataset.value) || 0, 0), 100);
                bar.style.width = '0%';
                setTimeout(function() { bar.style.width = value + '%'; }, 200);
            });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', animate);
    } else {
        animate();
    }
})();


/* ── 12. CHART.JS GLOBAL DEFAULTS ───────────────────────── */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;

    Chart.defaults.font.family =
        "'Segoe UI', 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif";
    Chart.defaults.font.size = 13;
    Chart.defaults.color     = '#6c757d';

    Chart.defaults.plugins.legend.labels.padding       = 20;
    Chart.defaults.plugins.legend.labels.usePointStyle = true;

    Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.backgroundColor = '#212529';
    Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.titleColor      = '#ffffff';
    Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.bodyColor       = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.padding         = 12;
    Chart.defaults.plugins.tooltip.cornerRadius    = 8;

    Chart.defaults.animation.duration = 800;
    Chart.defaults.animation.easing   = 'easeInOutQuart';

    window.AgriChartColors = {
        green: '#2d6a4f', gold: '#f59f00', blue: '#1976d2',
        orange: '#f76707', red: '#e03131', gray: '#adb5bd'
    };
});


/* ── 13. TABLE SEARCH FILTER ─────────────────────────────── */
function filterTable(input) {
    const table = document.querySelector(input.dataset.tableFilter);
    if (!table) return;
    const query = input.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(function(row) {
        row.style.display = row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query) ? '' : 'none';
    });
}

document.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
    if (e.target.dataset.tableFilter) filterTable(e.target);
});


/* ── 14. TOAST NOTIFICATION ──────────────────────────────── */
function showToast(message, type, duration) {
    type     = type     || 'info';
    duration = duration || 5000;

    const icons     = { success:'✅', info:'ℹ️', warning:'⚠️', danger:'❌' };
    const container = document.getElementById('flashContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = 'alert alert-' + type + ' flash-message';
    toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
    toast.innerHTML =
        '<span class="alert-icon">' + (icons[type] || 'ℹ️') + '</span>' +
        '<div class="alert-content"><p class="alert-text">' + message + '</p></div>' +
        '<button class="alert-close" onclick="dismissFlash(this.closest(\'.flash-message\'))">✕</button>';

    container.appendChild(toast);
    setTimeout(function() { dismissFlash(toast); }, duration);
}


/* ── 15. UTILITIES ───────────────────────────────────────── */
function formatNaira(value) {
    return '₦' + parseFloat(value || 0).toLocaleString('en-NG', {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2
    });
}

function formatFileSize(bytes) {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B';
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(1024, i)).toFixed(1)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
}

function debounce(func, wait) {
    let timeout;
    return function() {
        const ctx  = this;
        const args = arguments;
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        timeout = setTimeout(function() { func.apply(ctx, args); }, wait);
    };
}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Contact Page — Scripts
   ============================================================= */

/* ── FAQ Accordion ───────────────────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(function(btn) {

    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const item    = this.closest('.faq-item');
        const answer  = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
        const icon    = this.querySelector('.faq-icon');
        const isOpen  = answer.style.display === 'block';

        /* Close all other open items */
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function(el) {
            el.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.display = 'none';
            el.querySelector('.faq-icon').textContent     = '+';
            el.querySelector('.faq-icon').style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
            el.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute(
                'aria-expanded', 'false'
            );
            el.querySelector('.faq-question').style.background =
                'var(--gray-50)';
        });

        /* Open this item if it was closed */
        if (!isOpen) {
            answer.style.display           = 'block';
            icon.textContent               = '×';
            icon.style.transform           = 'rotate(45deg)';
            this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            this.style.background          = 'var(--green-ghost)';
        }
    });

    /* Hover effect */
    btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        if (this.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') {
            this.style.background = 'var(--gray-100)';
        }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        if (this.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') {
            this.style.background = 'var(--gray-50)';
        }
    });

});


/* ── Contact Form Validation and Submit ──────────────────── */
document.getElementById('contactForm').addEventListener(
    'submit',
    function(e) {
        const name     = document.getElementById('sender_name').value.trim();
        const email    = document.getElementById('sender_email').value.trim();
        const category = document.getElementById('category').value;
        const subject  = document.getElementById('subject').value.trim();
        const message  = document.getElementById('message').value.trim();

        let valid  = true;
        const errs = [];

        if (!name || name.length < 2) {
            errs.push('Please enter your full name.');
            valid = false;
        }

        if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
            errs.push('Please enter a valid email address.');
            valid = false;
        }

        if (!category) {
            errs.push('Please select a message category.');
            valid = false;
        }

        if (!subject || subject.length < 5) {
            errs.push('Please enter a subject (at least 5 characters).');
            valid = false;
        }

        if (!message || message.length < 20) {
            errs.push('Please enter your message (at least 20 characters).');
            valid = false;
        }

        if (!valid) {
            e.preventDefault();
            errs.forEach(function(err) {
                showToast(err, 'danger', 6000);
            });
            return;
        }

        /* Show loading state */
        const btn     = document.getElementById('contactSubmitBtn');
        const btnText = document.getElementById('contactBtnText');
        btn.disabled        = true;
        btn.classList.add('loading');
        btnText.textContent = 'Sending...';
    }
);


/* ── Social link hover ────────────────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.social-link').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.background = 'var(--green-ghost)';
    });
    link.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.background = 'var(--gray-50)';
    });
});


/* ── Responsive contact grid ──────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('contactGrid');
    if (!grid) return;
    function adj() {
        grid.style.gridTemplateColumns =
            window.innerWidth <= 991 ? '1fr' : '1fr 400px';
    }
    adj();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adj);
})();

</script>
{% endblock %}

{# ============================================================
   PAGE-SPECIFIC SCRIPTS
   Landing page animations and interactivity.
   ============================================================ #}
{% block scripts %}
<script>
/* =============================================================
   Landing Page — Page Scripts
   Handles:
       - How-it-works card hover animations
       - Category link hover effects
       - Count-up animation for stat numbers
       - Intersection Observer for scroll animations
   ============================================================= */

'use strict';

/* ── 1. HOW-IT-WORKS CARD HOVER ─────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.how-step-card').forEach(function(card) {

    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.transform   = 'translateY(-6px)';
        this.style.boxShadow   = 'var(--shadow-xl)';
        this.style.borderColor = 'var(--green-pale)';

        const icon = this.querySelector('div:nth-child(2)');
        if (icon) icon.style.transform = 'scale(1.12) rotate(-5deg)';
    });

    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.transform   = '';
        this.style.boxShadow   = '';
        this.style.borderColor = '';

        const icon = this.querySelector('div:nth-child(2)');
        if (icon) icon.style.transform = '';
    });

});


/* ── 2. CATEGORY LINK HOVER ─────────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.category-link').forEach(function(link) {

    link.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.transform   = 'translateY(-4px)';
        this.style.boxShadow   = 'var(--shadow-lg)';
        this.style.borderColor = 'var(--green-pale)';

        const icon = this.querySelector('div');
        if (icon) icon.style.transform = 'scale(1.1) rotate(-5deg)';
    });

    link.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.transform   = '';
        this.style.boxShadow   = '';
        this.style.borderColor = '';

        const icon = this.querySelector('div');
        if (icon) icon.style.transform = '';
    });

});


/* ── 3. COUNT-UP ANIMATION FOR STATS ───────────────────── */
/**
 * Animate a numeric stat element from 0 to its target value.
 * Handles suffixes like '+', '%', ',' automatically.
 *
 * @param {HTMLElement} el      - The element to animate
 * @param {number}      target  - The target numeric value
 * @param {string}      suffix  - Any suffix to append ('+', '%', etc.)
 * @param {number}      duration - Animation duration in ms
 */
function animateCount(el, target, suffix, duration) {
    suffix   = suffix   || '';
    duration = duration || 1800;

    const start     = 0;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    /* Easing function — ease out cubic */
    function easeOutCubic(t) {
        return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
    }

    function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed  = currentTime - startTime;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased    = easeOutCubic(progress);
        const current  = Math.round(start + (target - start) * eased);

        /* Format with comma thousands separator */
        el.textContent = current.toLocaleString('en-NG') + suffix;

        if (progress < 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
            /* Ensure exact final value */
            el.textContent = target.toLocaleString('en-NG') + suffix;
        }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(update);
}

/* Parse stat values from their display text */
function parseStatValue(text) {
    /* Extract number and suffix from strings like '500+', '95%', '1,000+' */
    const cleaned = text.replace(/,/g, '');
    const match   = cleaned.match(/^([\d.]+)(.*)$/);

    if (!match) return { value: 0, suffix: '' };

    return {
        value:  parseFloat(match[1]),
        suffix: match[2].trim()
    };
}


/* ── 4. INTERSECTION OBSERVER — SCROLL ANIMATIONS ────────── */
/**
 * Triggers animations when elements scroll into the viewport.
 * Used for:
 *   - Stat count-up numbers
 *   - Feature card fade-in
 *   - Step card fade-in
 */
(function() {

    /* ── Stat count-up observer ── */
    const statValues = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-block-value');

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && statValues.length > 0) {

        const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
            function(entries, observer) {
                entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

                    const el      = entry.target;
                    const parsed  = parseStatValue(el.textContent);

                    /* Start count-up animation */
                    animateCount(el, parsed.value, parsed.suffix, 1800);

                    /* Only animate once */
                    observer.unobserve(el);
                });
            },
            { threshold: 0.5 }
        );

        statValues.forEach(function(el) {
            statsObserver.observe(el);
        });
    }


    /* ── Feature card fade-in observer ── */
    const featureCards = document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card');

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && featureCards.length > 0) {

        /* Set initial state */
        featureCards.forEach(function(card, index) {
            card.style.opacity   = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
            card.style.transition =
                'opacity 0.5s ease ' + (index * 0.08) + 's, ' +
                'transform 0.5s ease ' + (index * 0.08) + 's';
        });

        const cardsObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
            function(entries, observer) {
                entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

                    entry.target.style.opacity   = '1';
                    entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';

                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                });
            },
            { threshold: 0.15 }
        );

        featureCards.forEach(function(card) {
            cardsObserver.observe(card);
        });
    }


    /* ── How-it-works step card fade-in observer ── */
    const stepCards = document.querySelectorAll('.how-step-card');

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && stepCards.length > 0) {

        stepCards.forEach(function(card, index) {
            card.style.opacity   = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            card.style.transition =
                'opacity 0.45s ease ' + (index * 0.1) + 's, ' +
                'transform 0.45s ease ' + (index * 0.1) + 's, ' +
                'box-shadow 0.25s ease, ' +
                'border-color 0.25s ease';
        });

        const stepsObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
            function(entries, observer) {
                entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

                    entry.target.style.opacity   = '1';
                    entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';

                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                });
            },
            { threshold: 0.2 }
        );

        stepCards.forEach(function(card) {
            stepsObserver.observe(card);
        });
    }


    /* ── Course card fade-in observer ── */
    const courseCards = document.querySelectorAll('.course-card');

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && courseCards.length > 0) {

        courseCards.forEach(function(card, index) {
            card.style.opacity   = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            card.style.transition =
                'opacity 0.5s ease ' + (index * 0.1) + 's, ' +
                'transform 0.5s ease ' + (index * 0.1) + 's, ' +
                'box-shadow 0.25s ease, ' +
                'border-color 0.25s ease';
        });

        const coursesObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
            function(entries, observer) {
                entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

                    entry.target.style.opacity   = '1';
                    entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';

                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                });
            },
            { threshold: 0.1 }
        );

        courseCards.forEach(function(card) {
            coursesObserver.observe(card);
        });
    }

})();


/* ── 5. SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS ──────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(anchor) {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
        if (!target) return;

        e.preventDefault();

        target.scrollIntoView({
            behavior: 'smooth',
            block:    'start'
        });
    });
});


/* ── 6. HERO ENTRANCE ANIMATION ──────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const heroContent = document.querySelector('.landing-hero-content');
    if (!heroContent) return;

    heroContent.style.opacity   = '0';
    heroContent.style.transform = 'translateY(30px)';
    heroContent.style.transition = 'opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease';

    /* Trigger after a short delay for natural feel */
    setTimeout(function() {
        heroContent.style.opacity   = '1';
        heroContent.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    }, 150);
})();


/* ── 7. COURSE CARD HOVER ENHANCEMENT ────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.course-card').forEach(function(card) {

    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        const thumbnail = this.querySelector('.course-card-thumbnail');
        if (thumbnail) {
            thumbnail.style.transform  = 'scale(1.03)';
            thumbnail.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s ease';
        }
    });

    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        const thumbnail = this.querySelector('.course-card-thumbnail');
        if (thumbnail) {
            thumbnail.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
        }
    });

});

</script>
{% endblock %}
{# end scripts block #}

<script>
/* =============================================================
   Admin Dashboard — Chart.js Visualizations
   Renders:
       1. Monthly Enrollment Trend Line Chart
       2. User Registration Trend Bar Chart
       3. Submission Status Doughnut Chart
   ============================================================= */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    /* ── Chart data from Flask template ─────────────────────── */
    const monthlyLabels      = {{ monthly_labels      | tojson }};
    const monthlyEnrollments = {{ monthly_enrollments | tojson }};
    const regLabels          = {{ reg_labels          | tojson }};
    const regCounts          = {{ reg_counts          | tojson }};

    const subStatus = {
        pending:  {{ submission_status.pending }},
        graded:   {{ submission_status.graded }},
        returned: {{ submission_status.returned }},
    };


    /* ── 1. MONTHLY ENROLLMENT TREND — LINE CHART ────────────── */
    const enrollCtx = document.getElementById('enrollmentTrendChart');

    if (enrollCtx) {
        new Chart(enrollCtx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: monthlyLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'New Enrollments',
                    data: monthlyEnrollments,
                    borderColor:     '#2d6a4f',
                    backgroundColor: function(context) {
                        const chart = context.chart;
                        const { ctx, chartArea } = chart;
                        if (!chartArea) return 'rgba(45,106,79,0.1)';
                        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(
                            0, chartArea.top, 0, chartArea.bottom
                        );
                        gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(45,106,79,0.3)');
                        gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(45,106,79,0.01)');
                        return gradient;
                    },
                    borderWidth:  2.5,
                    pointBackgroundColor:  '#2d6a4f',
                    pointBorderColor:      '#fff',
                    pointBorderWidth:      2,
                    pointRadius:           5,
                    pointHoverRadius:      7,
                    fill:        true,
                    tension:     0.4,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive:          true,
                maintainAspectRatio: true,
                interaction: {
                    mode:      'index',
                    intersect: false,
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                                const v = context.parsed.y;
                                return ' ' + v +
                                    ' enrollment' + (v !== 1 ? 's' : '');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        ticks: {
                            stepSize:  1,
                            precision: 0,
                            color:     '#6c757d',
                        },
                        grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }
                    },
                    x: {
                        ticks: {
                            color: '#6c757d',
                            font: { size: 11, weight: '600' }
                        },
                        grid: { display: false }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }


    /* ── 2. REGISTRATION TREND — BAR CHART ───────────────────── */
    const regCtx = document.getElementById('registrationChart');

    if (regCtx) {
        new Chart(regCtx, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: regLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'New Users',
                    data: regCounts,
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.75)',
                    borderColor:     'rgba(25, 118, 210, 1)',
                    borderWidth:     2,
                    borderRadius:    6,
                    borderSkipped:   false,
                    hoverBackgroundColor: 'rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.95)',
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive:          true,
                maintainAspectRatio: true,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                                const v = context.parsed.y;
                                return ' ' + v +
                                    ' new user' + (v !== 1 ? 's' : '');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        ticks: {
                            stepSize:  1,
                            precision: 0,
                            color:     '#6c757d',
                        },
                        grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }
                    },
                    x: {
                        ticks: {
                            color: '#6c757d',
                            font: { size: 11, weight: '600' }
                        },
                        grid: { display: false }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }


    /* ── 3. SUBMISSION STATUS — DOUGHNUT CHART ───────────────── */
    const subCtx = document.getElementById('submissionStatusChart');

    if (subCtx) {
        const total = subStatus.pending +
                      subStatus.graded +
                      subStatus.returned;

        if (total > 0) {
            new Chart(subCtx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Pending', 'Graded', 'Returned'],
                    datasets: [{
                        data: [
                            subStatus.pending,
                            subStatus.graded,
                            subStatus.returned,
                        ],
                        backgroundColor: [
                            'rgba(247, 103,   7, 0.85)',
                            'rgba( 64, 145, 108, 0.85)',
                            'rgba(224,  49,  49, 0.85)',
                        ],
                        borderColor: [
                            '#f76707',
                            '#40916c',
                            '#e03131',
                        ],
                        borderWidth:  2,
                        hoverOffset:  5,
                        borderRadius: 4,
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive:          true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: true,
                    cutout:              '65%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    const v   = context.parsed;
                                    const pct = Math.round(
                                        (v / total) * 100
                                    );
                                    return ' ' + context.label +
                                           ': ' + v +
                                           ' (' + pct + '%)';
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                plugins: [{
                    id: 'centerLabel',
                    afterDraw: function(chart) {
                        const { ctx, chartArea } = chart;
                        if (!chartArea) return;

                        const cx = (chartArea.left + chartArea.right) / 2;
                        const cy = (chartArea.top + chartArea.bottom) / 2;

                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.font         = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                        ctx.fillStyle    = '#212529';
                        ctx.textAlign    = 'center';
                        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                        ctx.fillText(total, cx, cy - 8);

                        ctx.font      = '11px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#6c757d';
                        ctx.fillText('Total', cx, cy + 10);
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                }]
            });
        }
    }


    /* ── 4. RESPONSIVE GRID ADJUSTMENT ──────────────────────── */
    function adjustAdminGrid() {
        const grid = document.getElementById('adminMainGrid');
        if (!grid) return;

        if (window.innerWidth <= 991) {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
        } else {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 380px';
        }
    }

    adjustAdminGrid();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjustAdminGrid);

});
/* end DOMContentLoaded */
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Grading Interface — Live Score Calculator
   ============================================================= */

const scoreInput   = document.getElementById('scoreInput');
const percentDisp  = document.getElementById('percentDisplay');
const letterDisp   = document.getElementById('gradeLetterDisplay');
const labelDisp    = document.getElementById('gradeLabelDisplay');
const passDisp     = document.getElementById('passFailDisplay');
const progressBar  = document.getElementById('scoreProgressBar');

const maxMarks  = {{ assignment.total_marks | float if assignment else 100 }};
const passMarks = {{ assignment.pass_mark | float if assignment else 50 }};

const GRADE_COLORS = {
    'A': '#2d6a4f', 'B': '#1976d2',
    'C': '#f59f00', 'D': '#f76707', 'F': '#e03131'
};

const GRADE_LABELS = {
    'A': 'Distinction', 'B': 'Merit',
    'C': 'Pass',        'D': 'Below Pass', 'F': 'Fail'
};

function getGradeLetter(pct) {
    if (pct >= 70) return 'A';
    if (pct >= 60) return 'B';
    if (pct >= 50) return 'C';
    if (pct >= 40) return 'D';
    return 'F';
}

function updateScoreDisplay() {
    const score = parseFloat(scoreInput.value) || 0;
    const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(score, 0), maxMarks);
    const pct   = maxMarks > 0
        ? Math.round((clamped / maxMarks) * 100 * 10) / 10
        : 0;
    const letter = getGradeLetter(pct);
    const color  = GRADE_COLORS[letter] || '#6c757d';
    const passed = clamped >= passMarks;

    /* Update percent display */
    if (percentDisp) {
        percentDisp.textContent = pct + '%';
        percentDisp.style.color = color;
    }

    /* Update grade letter badge */
    if (letterDisp) {
        letterDisp.textContent    = letter;
        letterDisp.style.background = color;
        letterDisp.style.color    = 'white';
        letterDisp.style.display  = 'flex';
        letterDisp.style.alignItems = 'center';
        letterDisp.style.justifyContent = 'center';
        letterDisp.style.borderRadius = '0.5rem';
    }

    /* Update label */
    if (labelDisp) {
        labelDisp.textContent = GRADE_LABELS[letter] || '';
        labelDisp.style.color = color;
    }

    /* Update pass/fail */
    if (passDisp) {
        passDisp.textContent = passed
            ? '✅ Will pass (≥ ' + passMarks + ' marks)'
            : '❌ Will not pass (< ' + passMarks + ' marks)';
        passDisp.style.color = passed
            ? 'var(--green-mid)'
            : 'var(--red-mid)';
    }

    /* Update progress bar */
    if (progressBar) {
        progressBar.style.width  = pct + '%';
        progressBar.style.background = color;
    }
}

if (scoreInput) {
    scoreInput.addEventListener('input', updateScoreDisplay);
    /* Run on page load if editing existing grade */
    if (scoreInput.value) updateScoreDisplay();
}


/* ── Responsive layout ───────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const layout = document.getElementById('gradeLayout');
    if (!layout) return;
    function adj() {
        layout.style.gridTemplateColumns =
            window.innerWidth <= 991 ? '1fr' : '1fr 380px';
    }
    adj();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adj);
})();


/* ── Grade form loading state ────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const form = document.getElementById('gradingForm');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('gradeSubmitBtn');
    if (!form || !btn) return;
    form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
        btn.disabled    = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Saving grade...';
        btn.classList.add('loading');
    });
})();

</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* Toggle external URL vs file upload */
const isExternalChk   = document.getElementById('isExternal');
const fileSection     = document.getElementById('fileUploadSection');
const externalSection = document.getElementById('externalUrlSection');

if (isExternalChk) {
    function toggleSource() {
        const isExt = isExternalChk.checked;
        if (fileSection)     fileSection.style.display     = isExt ? 'none' : 'block';
        if (externalSection) externalSection.style.display = isExt ? 'block' : 'none';
    }
    isExternalChk.addEventListener('change', toggleSource);
    toggleSource();
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
'use strict';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    /* ── Chart data passed from Flask context processor ── */
    const monthlyLabels      = {{ monthly_labels      | tojson }};
    const monthlyEnrollments = {{ monthly_enrollments | tojson }};
    const regLabels          = {{ reg_labels          | tojson }};
    const regCounts          = {{ reg_counts          | tojson }};
    const subStatus = {
        pending:  {{ submission_status.pending }},
        graded:   {{ submission_status.graded }},
        returned: {{ submission_status.returned }},
    };
    const topCourses = {
        labels: [{% for c, n in top_courses %}'{{ c.title | truncate_words(4) }}'{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}],
        data:   [{% for c, n in top_courses %}{{ n }}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}],
    };

    /* ── 1. Enrollment Trend Line Chart ── */
    const ec = document.getElementById('rptEnrollChart');
    if (ec) {
        new Chart(ec, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: monthlyLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Enrollments',
                    data: monthlyEnrollments,
                    borderColor: '#2d6a4f',
                    backgroundColor: function(ctx) {
                        const { chartArea, ctx: c } = ctx.chart;
                        if (!chartArea) return 'rgba(45,106,79,0.1)';
                        const g = c.createLinearGradient(
                            0, chartArea.top, 0, chartArea.bottom);
                        g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(45,106,79,0.3)');
                        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(45,106,79,0.0)');
                        return g;
                    },
                    borderWidth: 2.5,
                    pointBackgroundColor: '#2d6a4f',
                    pointBorderColor: '#fff',
                    pointBorderWidth: 2,
                    pointRadius: 5,
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.4,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                scales: {
                    y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { precision: 0 } },
                    x: { grid: { display: false } }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /* ── 2. Registration Bar Chart ── */
    const rc = document.getElementById('rptRegChart');
    if (rc) {
        new Chart(rc, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: regLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Registrations',
                    data: regCounts,
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(25,118,210,0.75)',
                    borderColor: 'rgba(25,118,210,1)',
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    borderSkipped: false,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                scales: {
                    y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { precision: 0 } },
                    x: { grid: { display: false } }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /* ── 3. Submission Status Doughnut ── */
    const sc = document.getElementById('rptSubChart');
    if (sc) {
        const total = subStatus.pending +
                      subStatus.graded +
                      subStatus.returned;
        if (total > 0) {
            new Chart(sc, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Pending','Graded','Returned'],
                    datasets: [{
                        data: [subStatus.pending,
                               subStatus.graded,
                               subStatus.returned],
                        backgroundColor: ['rgba(247,103,7,0.85)',
                                          'rgba(64,145,108,0.85)',
                                          'rgba(224,49,49,0.85)'],
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        hoverOffset: 5,
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    cutout: '65%',
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false } }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    /* ── 4. Top Courses Horizontal Bar ── */
    const cc = document.getElementById('rptCourseChart');
    if (cc && topCourses.labels.length > 0) {
        new Chart(cc, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: topCourses.labels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Enrollments',
                    data: topCourses.data,
                    backgroundColor: [
                        'rgba(45,106,79,0.8)',
                        'rgba(25,118,210,0.8)',
                        'rgba(245,159,0,0.8)',
                        'rgba(247,103,7,0.8)',
                        'rgba(224,49,49,0.8)',
                    ],
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    borderSkipped: false,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                indexAxis: 'y',
                responsive: true,
                plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                scales: {
                    x: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { precision: 0 } },
                    y: { grid: { display: false } }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /* ── Responsive grids ── */
    function adjGrids() {
        const cg = document.getElementById('chartsGrid');
        const mg = document.getElementById('metricsGrid');
        const cols = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? '1fr' : '1fr 1fr';
        if (cg)   cg.style.gridTemplateColumns = cols;
        if (mg)   mg.style.gridTemplateColumns = cols;
    }
    adjGrids();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjGrids);

});
</script>
{% endblock %}

   Login Page — Scripts
   Handles:
       - Password visibility toggle
       - Form submit loading state
       - Client-side validation
