/* ── Password Toggle ──────────────────────────────────────── */
document.getElementById('togglePassword').addEventListener('click',
    function() {
        const input  = document.getElementById('password');
        const isText = input.type === 'text';
        input.type   = isText ? 'password' : 'text';
        this.textContent = isText ? '👁️' : '🙈';
        this.setAttribute('aria-label',
            isText ? 'Show password' : 'Hide password');
    }
);


/* ── Form Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit',
    function(e) {

    const email    = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
    const password = document.getElementById('password').value;

    let isValid = true;

    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
        showToast('Please enter a valid email address.', 'danger');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (!password) {
        showToast('Please enter your password.', 'danger');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (!isValid) {
        e.preventDefault();
        return;
    }

    /* Loading state */
    const btn     = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
    const btnText = document.getElementById('submitBtnText');
    btn.disabled        = true;
    btn.classList.add('loading');
    btnText.textContent = 'Logging in...';
});


/* ── Auto-focus email field ───────────────────────────────── */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const emailField = document.getElementById('email');
    if (emailField && !emailField.value) {
        emailField.focus();
    }
});

</script>

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Registration Page — Scripts
   Handles:
       - Password visibility toggle
       - Real-time password strength indicator
       - Real-time password match check
       - Form submit loading state
       - Client-side validation before submit
   ============================================================= */

/* ── Password Visibility Toggles ─────────────────────────── */
document.getElementById('togglePassword').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const input = document.getElementById('password');
    const isText = input.type === 'text';
    input.type = isText ? 'password' : 'text';
    this.textContent = isText ? '👁️' : '🙈';
    this.setAttribute('aria-label',
        isText ? 'Show password' : 'Hide password');
});

document.getElementById('toggleConfirm').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const input = document.getElementById('confirm_password');
    const isText = input.type === 'text';
    input.type = isText ? 'password' : 'text';
    this.textContent = isText ? '👁️' : '🙈';
    this.setAttribute('aria-label',
        isText ? 'Show password' : 'Hide password');
});


/* ── Password Strength Indicator ─────────────────────────── */
function calculateStrength(password) {
    if (!password) return 0;

    let score = 0;

    /* Length check */
    if (password.length >= 8)  score++;
    if (password.length >= 12) score++;

    /* Complexity checks */
    if (/[a-z]/.test(password) && /[A-Z]/.test(password)) score++;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
    if (/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/.test(password)) score++;

    /* Cap at 4 */
    return Math.min(score, 4);
}

document.getElementById('password').addEventListener('input', function() {
    const strength = calculateStrength(this.value);
    const bars     = document.querySelectorAll('.strength-bar');
    const label    = document.getElementById('strengthLabel');

    const colors = {
        0: 'var(--gray-200)',
        1: 'var(--red-mid)',
        2: 'var(--orange-mid)',
        3: 'var(--gold-mid)',
        4: 'var(--green-mid)'
    };

    const labels = {
        0: 'Enter a password to see strength',
        1: '⚠️ Very weak — add more characters',
        2: '🔶 Weak — add numbers or symbols',
        3: '🔷 Good — almost there',
        4: '✅ Strong password'
    };

    const labelColors = {
        0: 'var(--gray-400)',
        1: 'var(--red-mid)',
        2: 'var(--orange-mid)',
        3: 'var(--gold-dark)',
        4: 'var(--green-mid)'
    };

    bars.forEach(function(bar) {
        const level = parseInt(bar.dataset.level, 10);
        bar.style.background = level <= strength
            ? colors[strength]
            : 'var(--gray-200)';
    });

    label.textContent   = labels[strength];
    label.style.color   = labelColors[strength];

    /* Also update match indicator if confirm has a value */
    const confirm = document.getElementById('confirm_password');
    if (confirm.value) {
        updateMatchIndicator(this.value, confirm.value);
    }
});


/* ── Password Match Indicator ─────────────────────────────── */
function updateMatchIndicator(password, confirm) {
    const indicator = document.getElementById('matchIndicator');

    if (!confirm) {
        indicator.textContent = '';
        return;
    }

    if (password === confirm) {
        indicator.textContent   = '✅ Passwords match';
        indicator.style.color   = 'var(--green-mid)';
    } else {
        indicator.textContent   = '❌ Passwords do not match';
        indicator.style.color   = 'var(--red-mid)';
    }
}

document.getElementById('confirm_password').addEventListener('input', function() {
    const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
    updateMatchIndicator(password, this.value);
});


/* ── Form Submit Validation ───────────────────────────────── */
document.getElementById('registrationForm').addEventListener('submit',
    function(e) {

    const fullName    = document.getElementById('full_name').value.trim();
    const email       = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
    const password    = document.getElementById('password').value;
    const confirm     = document.getElementById('confirm_password').value;
    const agreeTerms  = document.getElementById('agree_terms').checked;

    let isValid = true;
    const errors = [];

    if (!fullName || fullName.length < 2) {
        errors.push('Please enter your full name (at least 2 characters).');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
        errors.push('Please enter a valid email address.');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
        errors.push('Password must be at least 8 characters long.');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (password !== confirm) {
        errors.push('Passwords do not match.');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (!agreeTerms) {
        errors.push('Please agree to the Terms of Service to continue.');
        isValid = false;
    }

    if (!isValid) {
        e.preventDefault();
        errors.forEach(function(err) {
            showToast(err, 'danger', 6000);
        });
        return;
    }

    /* Show loading state on submit button */
    const btn     = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
    const btnText = document.getElementById('submitBtnText');
    btn.disabled          = true;
    btn.classList.add('loading');
    btnText.textContent   = 'Creating account...';
});

</script>
{% endblock %}

{% macro render_assignment_card(assignment, submission) %}

<div class="assignment-card"
     data-status="{% if submission %}{% if submission.is_graded %}graded
                  {% else %}submitted{% endif %}{% else %}pending{% endif %}">

    <div class="assignment-card-header">

        <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">

            <div style="display: flex;
                        align-items: center;
                        gap: 0.625rem;
                        flex-wrap: wrap;
                        margin-bottom: 0.375rem;">

                <h3 class="assignment-card-title">
                    {{ assignment.title }}
                </h3>

                {# Submission status badge #}
                {% if submission %}
                    {% if submission.is_graded %}
                    <span class="badge badge-success">✅ Graded</span>
                    {% else %}
                    <span class="badge badge-gold">📤 Submitted</span>
                    {% endif %}
                {% else %}
                    {% if assignment.is_past_due() %}
                    <span class="badge badge-danger">⚠️ Overdue</span>
                    {% else %}
                    <span class="badge badge-blue">⏳ Pending</span>
                    {% endif %}
                {% endif %}

                {# Late badge #}
                {% if submission and submission.is_late %}
                <span class="badge badge-orange">🕐 Late</span>
                {% endif %}

            </div>

            <div class="assignment-card-meta">

                <span>📚 {{ assignment.course.title
                            if assignment.course else 'Course' }}</span>

                <span>
                    {{ assignment.get_submission_type_label() }}
                </span>

                <span>
                    🎯 {{ assignment.total_marks | int }} marks
                </span>

                {% if assignment.due_date %}
                <span class="assignment-deadline
                    {% if assignment.is_past_due() and not submission %}overdue
                    {% elif assignment.get_days_until_due() is not none
                           and assignment.get_days_until_due() <= 3
                           and not submission %}due-soon{% endif %}">
                    📅 {{ assignment.get_due_date_display() }}
                </span>
                {% else %}
                <span class="assignment-deadline no-deadline">
                    No deadline
                </span>
                {% endif %}

                {% if submission %}
                <span style="color: var(--gray-400);">
                    Attempt {{ submission.attempt_number }}
                </span>
                {% endif %}

            </div>

                               assignment_id=assignment.id) }}"

        </p>

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Assignment List — Tab Navigation
   ============================================================= */

const ACTIVE_TAB_STYLE = {
    color:        'var(--green-dark)',
    borderColor:  'var(--green-dark)',
};

const INACTIVE_TAB_STYLE = {
    color:        'var(--gray-500)',
    borderColor:  'transparent',
};

function activateTab(tabId) {
    /* Hide all panels */
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(function(panel) {
        panel.style.display = 'none';
    });

    /* Reset all tab buttons */
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.style.color             = INACTIVE_TAB_STYLE.color;
        btn.style.borderBottomColor = INACTIVE_TAB_STYLE.borderColor;
    });

    /* Show selected panel */
    const panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + tabId);
    if (panel) panel.style.display = 'block';

    /* Activate selected tab button */
    const btn = document.getElementById('tab-' + tabId);
    if (btn) {
        btn.style.color             = ACTIVE_TAB_STYLE.color;
        btn.style.borderBottomColor = ACTIVE_TAB_STYLE.borderColor;

        /* Update count badge color */
        const badge = btn.querySelector('span');
        if (badge) {
            badge.style.background = 'var(--green-ghost)';
            badge.style.color      = 'var(--green-dark)';
        }
    }

    /* Save to sessionStorage */
    sessionStorage.setItem('agrilms_assignments_tab', tabId);
}

/* Attach click handlers */
document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        activateTab(this.dataset.tab);
    });
});

/* Restore last active tab */
const savedTab = sessionStorage.getItem('agrilms_assignments_tab') || 'all';
activateTab(savedTab);

</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Course Catalog — Scripts
   ============================================================= */

/* ── Live search with debounce ───────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    if (!searchInput) return;

    /* Submit form on Enter key press */
    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            document.getElementById('filterForm').submit();
        }
    });
})();


/* ── Filter grid responsive ──────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('filterGrid');
    if (!grid) return;

    function adjustGrid() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr';
        } else {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr auto auto auto';
        }
        if (window.innerWidth <= 480) {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
        }
    }

    adjustGrid();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjustGrid);
})();


/* ── Course card hover animation ─────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.course-card').forEach(function(card) {
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.transform  = 'translateY(-5px)';
        this.style.boxShadow  = 'var(--shadow-xl)';
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.transform  = '';
        this.style.boxShadow  = '';
    });
});

</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Course Detail — Scripts
   ============================================================= */

/* ── Responsive grid ─────────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('detailGrid');
    if (!grid) return;

    function adjust() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 991) {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
            /* Move right column before left on mobile */
        } else {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 340px';
        }
    }

    adjust();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjust);
})();


/* ── Module card hover ───────────────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.module-card:not(.locked)').forEach(
    function(card) {
        card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            this.style.borderColor = 'var(--green-light)';
            this.style.background  = 'var(--green-ghost)';
            this.style.transform   = 'translateX(4px)';
        });
        card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            if (!this.classList.contains('completed')) {
                this.style.borderColor = '';
                this.style.background  = '';
            }
            this.style.transform = '';
        });
    }
);

</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
/* =============================================================
   Learner Dashboard — Chart.js Visualizations
   Renders:
       1. Weekly Activity Bar Chart
       2. Course Progress Doughnut Chart
   ============================================================= */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    /* ── Chart Data from Flask template ─────────────────────── */
    const weeklyLabels   = {{ weekly_labels   | tojson }};
    const weeklyActivity = {{ weekly_activity | tojson }};

    const progressData = {
        completed:   {{ course_progress_data.completed }},
        in_progress: {{ course_progress_data.in_progress }},
        not_started: {{ course_progress_data.not_started }},
    };

    /* ── 1. WEEKLY ACTIVITY BAR CHART ───────────────────────── */
    const weeklyCtx = document.getElementById('weeklyActivityChart');

    if (weeklyCtx) {

        new Chart(weeklyCtx, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: weeklyLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Modules Completed',
                    data: weeklyActivity,
                    backgroundColor: function(context) {
                        const chart = context.chart;
                        const { ctx, chartArea } = chart;

                        if (!chartArea) return 'rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.7)';

                        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(
                            0, chartArea.top, 0, chartArea.bottom
                        );
                        gradient.addColorStop(0,   'rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.85)');
                        gradient.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(82, 183, 136, 0.4)');
                        return gradient;
                    },
                    borderColor:     'rgba(45, 106, 79, 1)',
                    borderWidth:     2,
                    borderRadius:    8,
                    borderSkipped:   false,
                    hoverBackgroundColor: 'rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.95)',
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive:          true,
                maintainAspectRatio: true,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                                const val = context.parsed.y;
                                return ' ' + val +
                                    ' module' + (val !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
                                    ' completed';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero:   true,
                        ticks: {
                            stepSize:  1,
                            precision: 0,
                            color:     '#6c757d',
                            font:      { size: 12 }
                        },
                        grid: {
                            color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)',
                        }
                    },
                    x: {
                        ticks: {
                            color: '#6c757d',
                            font:  { size: 12, weight: '600' }
                        },
                        grid: { display: false }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

    }
    /* end weekly activity chart */


    /* ── 2. COURSE PROGRESS DOUGHNUT CHART ──────────────────── */
    const progressCtx = document.getElementById('courseProgressChart');

    if (progressCtx) {

        const total = progressData.completed +
                      progressData.in_progress +
                      progressData.not_started;

        /* Show placeholder if no enrollments */
        if (total === 0) {
            progressCtx.parentNode.innerHTML =
                '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;' +
                'color:var(--gray-400);">No enrollment data yet.</div>';
        } else {

            new Chart(progressCtx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Completed', 'In Progress', 'Not Started'],
                    datasets: [{
                        data: [
                            progressData.completed,
                            progressData.in_progress,
                            progressData.not_started
                        ],
                        backgroundColor: [
                            'rgba(64, 145, 108, 0.9)',
                            'rgba(245, 159,   0, 0.9)',
                            'rgba(222, 226, 230, 0.9)'
                        ],
                        borderColor: [
                            '#40916c',
                            '#f59f00',
                            '#dee2e6'
                        ],
                        borderWidth:     2,
                        hoverOffset:     6,
                        borderRadius:    4,
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive:          true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: true,
                    cutout:              '68%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    const val   = context.parsed;
                                    const pct   = total > 0
                                        ? Math.round((val / total) * 100)
                                        : 0;
                                    return ' ' + context.label +
                                           ': ' + val +
                                           ' (' + pct + '%)';
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                plugins: [{
                    /* Center text plugin — shows overall % */
                    id: 'centerText',
                    afterDraw: function(chart) {
                        const { ctx, chartArea } = chart;
                        if (!chartArea) return;

                        const centerX = (chartArea.left + chartArea.right) / 2;
                        const centerY = (chartArea.top + chartArea.bottom) / 2;
                        const pct     = total > 0
                            ? Math.round((progressData.completed / total) * 100)
                            : 0;

                        ctx.save();

                        ctx.font         = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                        ctx.fillStyle    = '#1b4332';
                        ctx.textAlign    = 'center';
                        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                        ctx.fillText(pct + '%', centerX, centerY - 8);

                        ctx.font      = '12px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#6c757d';
                        ctx.fillText('Complete', centerX, centerY + 14);

                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                }]
            });

        }

    }
    /* end doughnut chart */


    /* ── 3. COURSE ROW CARD HOVER ────────────────────────────── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.course-row-card').forEach(function(card) {
        card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            this.style.borderColor  = 'var(--green-pale)';
            this.style.background   = 'var(--green-ghost)';
            this.style.boxShadow    = 'var(--shadow-md)';
        });
        card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            this.style.borderColor  = 'var(--color-border)';
            this.style.background   = 'var(--white)';
            this.style.boxShadow    = '';
        });
    });


    /* ── 4. RESPONSIVE LAYOUT ─────────────────────────────────── */
    function adjustLayout() {
        const mainGrid = document.querySelector(
            '[style*="grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px"]'
        );
        if (!mainGrid) return;

        if (window.innerWidth <= 991) {
            mainGrid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
        } else {
            mainGrid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 360px';
        }
    }

    adjustLayout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjustLayout);

});
/* end DOMContentLoaded */
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Module Viewer — Scripts
   Handles:
       - Responsive layout adjustment
       - Video player time tracking
       - Auto-save study notes
       - Mark complete button loading state
       - Time spent tracking (sent on page leave)
       - Module nav link hover
   ============================================================= */

/* ── 1. RESPONSIVE LAYOUT ────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const layout = document.getElementById('moduleLayout');
    if (!layout) return;

    function adjustLayout() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 991) {
            layout.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
        } else {
            layout.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 300px';
        }
    }

    adjustLayout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjustLayout);
})();


/* ── 2. TIME SPENT TRACKING ──────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const courseId  = {{ course.id }};
    const moduleId  = {{ module.id }};

    /* Send time spent when learner leaves the page */
    function sendTimeSpent() {
        const minutesSpent = Math.round(
            (Date.now() - startTime) / 60000
        );

        if (minutesSpent <= 0) return;

        /* Use sendBeacon for reliable page-leave sending */
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('minutes', minutesSpent);
        formData.append('csrf_token', '{{ csrf_token() }}');

        const url = '/courses/' + courseId +
                    '/modules/' + moduleId + '/time';

        if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
            navigator.sendBeacon(url, formData);
        } else {
            /* Fallback for older browsers */
            fetch(url, {
                method:      'POST',
                body:        formData,
                keepalive:   true,
            }).catch(function() {});
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', sendTimeSpent);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
            sendTimeSpent();
        }
    });
})();


/* ── 3. STUDY NOTES AUTO-SAVE ────────────────────────────── */
const courseIdForNotes  = {{ course.id }};
const moduleIdForNotes  = {{ module.id }};

let notesSaveTimeout = null;

function saveNotes() {
    const notes     = document.getElementById('studyNotes');
    const status    = document.getElementById('notesSaveStatus');
    const saveBtn   = document.getElementById('saveNotesBtn');

    if (!notes || !status) return;

    status.textContent = 'Saving...';
    status.style.color = 'var(--gray-400)';

    if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';
    }

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('notes',       notes.value);
    formData.append('csrf_token',  '{{ csrf_token() }}');

    fetch(
        '/courses/' + courseIdForNotes +
        '/modules/' + moduleIdForNotes + '/notes',
        {
            method: 'POST',
            body:   formData,
        }
    )
    .then(function(response) { return response.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
        if (data.success) {
            status.textContent = '✅ Notes saved at ' +
                new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            status.style.color = 'var(--green-mid)';
        } else {
            status.textContent = '❌ ' + (data.message || 'Save failed.');
            status.style.color = 'var(--red-mid)';
        }
    })
    .catch(function() {
        status.textContent = '❌ Save failed. Check your connection.';
        status.style.color = 'var(--red-mid)';
    })
    .finally(function() {
        if (saveBtn) {
            saveBtn.disabled    = false;
            saveBtn.textContent = '💾 Save Notes';
        }
        /* Reset status message after 4 seconds */
        setTimeout(function() {
            if (status) {
                status.textContent = 'Notes are saved automatically.';
                status.style.color = 'var(--gray-400)';
            }
        }, 4000);
    });
}

/* Auto-save notes after 3 seconds of inactivity */
(function() {
    const notesArea = document.getElementById('studyNotes');
    if (!notesArea) return;

    notesArea.addEventListener('input', function() {
        clearTimeout(notesSaveTimeout);
        const status = document.getElementById('notesSaveStatus');
        if (status) {
            status.textContent = 'Unsaved changes...';
            status.style.color = 'var(--orange-mid)';
        }
        notesSaveTimeout = setTimeout(saveNotes, 3000);
    });
})();


/* ── 4. MARK COMPLETE BUTTON LOADING STATE ───────────────── */
(function() {
    const form = document.getElementById('markCompleteForm');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('markCompleteBtn');

    if (!form || !btn) return;

    form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
        btn.disabled     = true;
        btn.textContent  = '⏳ Saving progress...';
        btn.classList.add('loading');
    });
})();


/* ── 5. PDF IFRAME LOAD TIMEOUT ──────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const iframe  = document.getElementById('pdfIframe');
    const loading = document.getElementById('pdfLoading');

    if (!iframe || !loading) return;

    /* Hide loading after 10 seconds regardless of load event */
    setTimeout(function() {
        if (loading.style.display !== 'none') {
            loading.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }, 10000);
})();


/* ── 6. VIDEO PLAYER ENHANCEMENTS ────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const video = document.getElementById('mainVideoPlayer');
    if (!video) return;

    /* Remember playback position in sessionStorage */
    const storageKey = 'agrilms_video_pos_{{ module.id }}_{{ primary_material.id if primary_material else 0 }}';

    /* Restore saved position */
    const savedTime = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    if (savedTime) {
        video.currentTime = parseFloat(savedTime);
    }

    /* Save position every 5 seconds while playing */
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', function() {
        if (Math.round(video.currentTime) % 5 === 0) {
            sessionStorage.setItem(
                storageKey,
                video.currentTime
            );
        }
    });

    /* Clear saved position when video ends */
    video.addEventListener('ended', function() {
        sessionStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
    });
})();


/* ── 7. MODULE NAV LINK HOVER ────────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.module-nav-link').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        if (!this.style.background.includes('green-ghost')) {
            this.style.background = 'var(--gray-50)';
        }
    });
    link.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        if (!this.style.background.includes('green-ghost')) {
            this.style.background = '';
        }
    });
});

</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

/* ── Responsive grid ─────────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('profileGrid');
    if (!grid) return;
    function adj() {
        grid.style.gridTemplateColumns =
            window.innerWidth <= 768 ? '1fr' : '300px 1fr';
    }
    adj();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adj);
})();

/* ── Quick link hover ────────────────────────────────────── */
document.querySelectorAll('.profile-quick-link').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.background = 'var(--green-ghost)';
    });
    link.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.background = '';
    });
});

/* ── Form save loading state ─────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const form = document.getElementById('profileForm');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('saveProfileBtn');
    if (!form || !btn) return;
    form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
        btn.disabled    = true;
        btn.textContent = '💾 Saving...';
        btn.classList.add('loading');
    });
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
'use strict';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    /* ── Overall Progress Doughnut ───────────────────────── */
    const ctx = document.getElementById('overallProgressChart');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const total     = {{ enrollments | length }};
    const completed = {{ enrollments | selectattr('is_completed')
                         | list | length }};
    const active    = {{ enrollments | selectattr('status','eq','active')
                         | rejectattr('is_completed') | list | length }};
    const notStart  = Math.max(0, total - completed - active);

    if (total > 0) {
        new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: ['Completed','In Progress','Not Started'],
                datasets: [{
                    data: [completed, active, notStart],
                    backgroundColor: [
                        'rgba(64,145,108,0.9)',
                        'rgba(245,159,0,0.9)',
                        'rgba(222,226,230,0.9)'
                    ],
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    hoverOffset: 5,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                cutout: '70%',
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(ctx) {
                                return ' ' + ctx.label +
                                    ': ' + ctx.parsed +
                                    ' course' +
                                    (ctx.parsed !== 1 ? 's' : '');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
            plugins: [{
                id: 'center',
                afterDraw: function(chart) {
                    const { ctx: c, chartArea } = chart;
                    if (!chartArea) return;
                    const cx = (chartArea.left + chartArea.right) / 2;
                    const cy = (chartArea.top + chartArea.bottom) / 2;
                    c.save();
                    c.font = 'bold 18px Segoe UI';
                    c.fillStyle = '#1b4332';
                    c.textAlign = 'center';
                    c.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    c.fillText(completed + '/' + total, cx, cy - 6);
                    c.font = '11px Segoe UI';
                    c.fillStyle = '#6c757d';
                    c.fillText('Courses', cx, cy + 10);
                    c.restore();
                }
            }]
        });
    }

});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
'use strict';

/* =============================================================
   Submission Form — Scripts
   ============================================================= */

/* ── Responsive layout ───────────────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const layout = document.getElementById('submitLayout');
    if (!layout) return;
    function adjust() {
        layout.style.gridTemplateColumns =
            window.innerWidth <= 991 ? '1fr' : '1fr 340px';
    }
    adjust();
    window.addEventListener('resize', adjust);
})();


/* ── Form submit loading state ───────────────────────────── */
(function() {
    const form    = document.getElementById('submissionForm');
    const btn     = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
    const btnText = document.getElementById('submitBtnText');

    if (!form || !btn) return;

    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        /* Client-side validation */
        const text = document.getElementById('text_content');
        const file = document.getElementById('submissionFile');

        const hasText = text && text.value.trim().length > 0;
        const hasFile = file && file.files && file.files.length > 0;

        if (!hasText && !hasFile) {
            e.preventDefault();
            showToast(
                'Please type an answer or upload a file before submitting.',
                'danger'
            );
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled     = true;
        btn.classList.add('loading');
        if (btnText) btnText.textContent = 'Submitting...';
    });
})();


/* ── Auto-save draft text to localStorage ────────────────── */
(function() {
    const textarea = document.getElementById('text_content');
    if (!textarea) return;

    const draftKey = 'agrilms_draft_{{ assignment.id }}';

    /* Restore draft */
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(draftKey);
    if (saved && !textarea.value) {
        textarea.value = saved;
    }

    /* Save draft as user types */
    textarea.addEventListener('input', debounce(function() {
        localStorage.setItem(draftKey, textarea.value);
    }, 1500));

    /* Clear draft on successful submit */
    const form = document.getElementById('submissionForm');
    if (form) {
        form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
            localStorage.removeItem(draftKey);
        });
    }
})();

</script>

# =============================================================
# Agri LMS — Custom Route Decorators
# =============================================================
# File    : app/utils/decorators.py
# Purpose : Reusable Flask route decorators for access
#           control, role checking, and request validation.
# =============================================================

from functools import wraps
from flask import redirect, url_for, flash, abort, request
from flask_login import current_user


# =============================================================
# ROLE-BASED ACCESS DECORATORS
# =============================================================

def admin_required(f):
    """
    Restrict a route to admin users only.

    Must be used AFTER @login_required to ensure the user
    is authenticated before the role check occurs.

    Usage:
        @app.route('/admin/dashboard')
        @login_required
        @admin_required
        def admin_dashboard():
            ...

    Returns:
        403 Forbidden if the user is not an admin.
    """
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        if not current_user.is_admin():
            flash(
                'Access denied. Administrator privileges required.',
                'error'
            )
            return redirect(url_for('learner.dashboard'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function


def learner_required(f):
    """
    Restrict a route to learner users only.
    Admins are redirected to the admin dashboard.

    Must be used AFTER @login_required.

    Usage:
        @app.route('/learner/dashboard')
        @login_required
        @learner_required
        def learner_dashboard():
            ...
    """
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        if current_user.is_admin():
            return redirect(url_for('admin.dashboard'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function


def active_account_required(f):
    """
    Ensure the authenticated user's account is active.
    Deactivated accounts are shown an error and redirected.

    Must be used AFTER @login_required.

    Usage:
        @app.route('/learner/courses')
        @login_required
        @active_account_required
        def courses():
            ...
    """
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        if not current_user.is_active:
            flash(
                'Your account has been deactivated. '
                'Please contact support for assistance.',
                'error'
            )
            from flask_login import logout_user
            logout_user()
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))
        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function


# =============================================================
# ENROLLMENT DECORATORS
# =============================================================

def enrollment_required(f):
    """
    Verify that the current learner is enrolled in the
    course specified by the course_id route parameter
    before allowing access to course content.

    Must be used AFTER @login_required.

    The decorated route MUST have a course_id parameter.

    Usage:
        @courses_bp.route('/<int:course_id>/content')
        @login_required
        @enrollment_required
        def course_content(course_id):
            ...
    """
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        if not current_user.is_authenticated:
            return redirect(url_for('auth.login'))

        # Admins bypass enrollment checks
        if current_user.is_admin():
            return f(*args, **kwargs)

        course_id = kwargs.get('course_id')
        if not course_id:
            abort(400)

        from app.models.enrollment import Enrollment
        enrollment = Enrollment.query.filter_by(
            user_id=current_user.id,
            course_id=course_id
        ).first()

        if not enrollment or not enrollment.can_access_content():
            flash(
                'You must be enrolled in this course '
                'to access its content.',
                'warning'
            )
            return redirect(url_for(
                'courses.course_detail',
                course_id=course_id
            ))

        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function

# =============================================================
# Agri LMS — Helper Utilities
# =============================================================
# File    : app/utils/helpers.py
# Purpose : General-purpose helper functions used across
#           the platform including pagination, formatting,
#           file handling, and data processing utilities.
# =============================================================

import os
import math
from datetime import datetime
from flask import current_app


# =============================================================
# PAGINATION HELPER
# =============================================================

class Pagination:
    """
    Simple pagination helper for manual query pagination
    when Flask-SQLAlchemy's built-in paginate() is not used.

    Usage:
        items = MyModel.query.all()
        paginator = Pagination(items, page=1, per_page=10)
        visible_items = paginator.items
    """

    def __init__(self, items, page, per_page):
        """
        Initialize the paginator.

        Args:
            items (list): Full list of items to paginate.
            page (int): Current page number (1-indexed).
            per_page (int): Number of items per page.
        """
        self.total    = len(items)
        self.per_page = per_page
        self.page     = max(1, page)
        self.pages    = math.ceil(self.total / per_page) if per_page else 1

        start       = (self.page - 1) * per_page
        end         = start + per_page
        self.items  = items[start:end]

    @property
    def has_prev(self):
        return self.page > 1

    @property
    def has_next(self):
        return self.page < self.pages

    @property
    def prev_num(self):
        return self.page - 1 if self.has_prev else None

    @property
    def next_num(self):
        return self.page + 1 if self.has_next else None

    def iter_pages(self, left_edge=2, right_edge=2,
                   left_current=2, right_current=2):
        """
        Generate page numbers for pagination UI rendering.
        Returns None where ellipsis (...) should appear.

        Yields:
            int or None: Page numbers or None for gaps.
        """
        last = 0
        for num in range(1, self.pages + 1):
            if (num <= left_edge or
                (self.page - left_current - 1 < num <
                 self.page + right_current) or
                    num > self.pages - right_edge):
                if last + 1 != num:
                    yield None
                yield num
                last = num


# =============================================================
# FILE SIZE FORMATTING
# =============================================================

def format_file_size(size_bytes):
    """
    Convert a file size in bytes to a human-readable string.

    Args:
        size_bytes (int): File size in bytes.

    Returns:
        str: Formatted file size string.

    Examples:
        500        → '500 B'
        15360      → '15.0 KB'
        2097152    → '2.0 MB'
        1073741824 → '1.0 GB'
    """
    if not size_bytes or size_bytes == 0:
        return '0 B'

    units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB']
    size  = float(size_bytes)
    unit  = 0

    while size >= 1024 and unit < len(units) - 1:
        size /= 1024
        unit += 1

    if unit == 0:
        return f'{int(size)} B'
    return f'{size:.1f} {units[unit]}'


# =============================================================
# CURRENCY FORMATTING
# =============================================================

def format_naira(amount):
    """
    Format a numeric amount as Nigerian Naira currency.

    Args:
        amount: Numeric value to format.

    Returns:
        str: Formatted Naira string.

    Examples:
        1500.0  → '₦1,500.00'
        250000  → '₦250,000.00'
    """
    try:
        return f'₦{float(amount):,.2f}'
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return '₦0.00'


# =============================================================
# DATE AND TIME FORMATTING
# =============================================================

def format_date(dt, fmt='%d %b %Y'):
    """
    Format a datetime object to a readable date string.

    Args:
        dt (datetime): Datetime to format.
        fmt (str): strftime format string.

    Returns:
        str: Formatted date string or 'N/A'.
    """
    if not dt:
        return 'N/A'
    try:
        return dt.strftime(fmt)
    except AttributeError:
        return 'N/A'


def format_datetime(dt, fmt='%d %b %Y at %I:%M %p'):
    """
    Format a datetime object to a readable date-time string.

    Args:
        dt (datetime): Datetime to format.
        fmt (str): strftime format string.

    Returns:
        str: Formatted datetime string or 'N/A'.
    """
    if not dt:
        return 'N/A'
    try:
        return dt.strftime(fmt)
    except AttributeError:
        return 'N/A'


def time_since(dt):
    """
    Return a human-readable relative time string describing
    how long ago a datetime was.

    Args:
        dt (datetime): The past datetime.

    Returns:
        str: Relative time string.

    Examples:
        30 seconds ago → 'Just now'
        5 minutes ago  → '5 minutes ago'
        2 days ago     → '2 days ago'
    """
    if not dt:
        return 'Unknown'

    try:
        now   = datetime.utcnow()
        delta = now - dt
        secs  = int(delta.total_seconds())

        if secs < 60:
            return 'Just now'
        elif secs < 3600:
            m = secs // 60
            return f'{m} minute{"s" if m != 1 else ""} ago'
        elif secs < 86400:
            h = secs // 3600
            return f'{h} hour{"s" if h != 1 else ""} ago'
        elif secs < 604800:
            d = secs // 86400
            return f'{d} day{"s" if d != 1 else ""} ago'
        elif secs < 2592000:
            w = secs // 604800
            return f'{w} week{"s" if w != 1 else ""} ago'
        else:
            return format_date(dt)

    except Exception:
        return 'Unknown'


# =============================================================
# TEXT UTILITIES
# =============================================================

def truncate_words(text, num_words=20, suffix='...'):
    """
    Truncate text to a maximum number of words.

    Args:
        text (str): Text to truncate.
        num_words (int): Maximum number of words.
        suffix (str): String appended when truncated.

    Returns:
        str: Truncated text with suffix if needed.
    """
    if not text:
        return ''
    words = str(text).split()
    if len(words) <= num_words:
        return text
    return ' '.join(words[:num_words]) + suffix


def truncate_chars(text, length=150, suffix='...'):
    """
    Truncate text to a maximum character length.

    Args:
        text (str): Text to truncate.
        length (int): Maximum character length.
        suffix (str): String appended when truncated.

    Returns:
        str: Truncated text with suffix if needed.
    """
    if not text:
        return ''
    text = str(text)
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text
    return text[:length].rstrip() + suffix


def slugify(text):
    """
    Convert a string to a URL-friendly slug.

    Converts to lowercase, replaces spaces and special
    characters with hyphens, and removes consecutive hyphens.

    Args:
        text (str): Text to slugify.

    Returns:
        str: URL-safe slug string.

    Examples:
        'Introduction to Crop Science'
        → 'introduction-to-crop-science'
    """
    import re
    if not text:
        return ''
    text = text.lower().strip()
    text = re.sub(r'[\s_]+', '-', text)
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w-]', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    return text.strip('-')


def parse_comma_list(text):
    """
    Parse a comma-separated string into a clean list.

    Args:
        text (str): Comma-separated string.

    Returns:
        list[str]: List of non-empty stripped strings.

    Examples:
        'maize, rice, cassava' → ['maize', 'rice', 'cassava']
    """
    if not text:
        return []
    return [item.strip() for item in text.split(',') if item.strip()]


def parse_newline_list(text):
    """
    Parse a newline-separated string into a clean list.

    Args:
        text (str): Newline-separated string.

    Returns:
        list[str]: List of non-empty stripped strings.
    """
    if not text:
        return []
    return [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]


# =============================================================
# GRADE CALCULATION
# =============================================================

def calculate_percentage(score, total):
    """
    Calculate a percentage score safely.

    Args:
        score (float): Score achieved.
        total (float): Maximum possible score.

    Returns:
        float: Percentage rounded to 2 decimal places.
               Returns 0.0 if total is zero.
    """
    try:
        if not total or float(total) <= 0:
            return 0.0
        return round((float(score) / float(total)) * 100, 2)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, ZeroDivisionError):
        return 0.0


def get_grade_letter(percentage):
    """
    Convert a percentage score to a letter grade.

    Grade scale:
        A — 70% and above   (Distinction)
        B — 60% to 69%      (Merit)
        C — 50% to 59%      (Pass)
        D — 40% to 49%      (Below Pass)
        F — Below 40%       (Fail)

    Args:
        percentage (float): Score percentage.

    Returns:
        str: Single letter grade.
    """
    try:
        pct = float(percentage)
        if pct >= 70: return 'A'
        if pct >= 60: return 'B'
        if pct >= 50: return 'C'
        if pct >= 40: return 'D'
        return 'F'
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return 'F'


def get_grade_label(letter):
    """
    Return a descriptive label for a grade letter.

    Args:
        letter (str): Grade letter (A, B, C, D, F).

    Returns:
        str: Full grade label.
    """
    labels = {
        'A': 'Distinction',
        'B': 'Merit',
        'C': 'Pass',
        'D': 'Below Pass',
        'F': 'Fail',
    }
    return labels.get(str(letter).upper(), 'Unknown')


# =============================================================
# UPLOAD DIRECTORY HELPERS
# =============================================================

def ensure_upload_dirs():
    """
    Create all required upload subdirectories if they
    do not exist. Called at application startup.
    """
    base = current_app.config.get(
        'UPLOAD_FOLDER', 'app/static/uploads')
    subdirs = ['materials', 'submissions', 'thumbnails', 'profiles']

    for subdir in subdirs:
        path = os.path.join(base, subdir)
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)


def get_upload_path(subdir, filename):
    """
    Build the full filesystem path for an uploaded file.

    Args:
        subdir (str): Upload subdirectory name.
        filename (str): Stored filename.

    Returns:
        str: Full filesystem path to the file.
    """
    base = current_app.config.get(
        'UPLOAD_FOLDER', 'app/static/uploads')
    return os.path.join(base, subdir, filename)


def file_exists(subdir, filename):
    """
    Check whether an uploaded file exists on the filesystem.

    Args:
        subdir (str): Upload subdirectory name.
        filename (str): Stored filename.

    Returns:
        bool: True if the file exists.
    """
    if not filename:
        return False
    path = get_upload_path(subdir, filename)
    return os.path.isfile(path)


def delete_upload_file(subdir, filename):
    """
    Safely delete an uploaded file from the filesystem.

    Args:
        subdir (str): Upload subdirectory name.
        filename (str): Stored filename to delete.

    Returns:
        bool: True if deleted, False if not found or error.
    """
    if not filename:
        return False
    try:
        path = get_upload_path(subdir, filename)
        if os.path.isfile(path):
            os.remove(path)
            return True
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        import logging
        logging.getLogger(__name__).error(
            f'Failed to delete file {filename}: {e}'
        )
        return False

# Agri LMS — Security Utilities

# Purpose : Platform-wide security helper functions including
#           input sanitization, file security validation,
#           rate limiting helpers, and security logging.

import re
import os
import hashlib
import logging
from functools import wraps
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from flask import request, abort, current_app
from flask_login import current_user


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# =============================================================
# INPUT SANITIZATION
# =============================================================

def sanitize_string(value, max_length=500, allow_html=False):
    """
    Sanitize a string input by stripping whitespace,
    removing dangerous HTML if not allowed, and
    enforcing a maximum length.

    Args:
        value (str): Raw input string.
        max_length (int): Maximum allowed length.
        allow_html (bool): If False, strips all HTML tags.

    Returns:
        str: Cleaned and safe string.
    """
    if not value:
        return ''

    # Convert to string and strip whitespace
    value = str(value).strip()

    # Strip HTML tags if not allowed
    if not allow_html:
        value = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', value)

    # Remove null bytes and other dangerous characters
    value = value.replace('\x00', '')
    value = value.replace('\r', '')

    # Enforce maximum length
    if len(value) > max_length:
        value = value[:max_length]

    return value


def sanitize_email(email):
    """
    Sanitize and normalize an email address.

    Args:
        email (str): Raw email input.

    Returns:
        str: Lowercased and stripped email, or empty string.
    """
    if not email:
        return ''
    return sanitize_string(email, max_length=150).lower()


def sanitize_filename(filename):
    """
    Sanitize an uploaded filename to prevent
    directory traversal and other file-based attacks.

    Args:
        filename (str): Original filename from upload.

    Returns:
        str: Safe filename with dangerous characters removed.
    """
    if not filename:
        return 'upload'

    # Remove directory separators and null bytes
    filename = filename.replace('/', '_').replace('\\', '_')
    filename = filename.replace('\x00', '')

    # Remove leading dots to prevent hidden file creation
    filename = filename.lstrip('.')

    # Allow only safe characters
    filename = re.sub(r'[^\w\-. ]', '_', filename)

    # Collapse multiple underscores
    filename = re.sub(r'_+', '_', filename)

    # Enforce maximum filename length
    if len(filename) > 200:
        name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
        filename  = name[:195] + ext

    return filename or 'upload'


def sanitize_integer(value, min_val=None, max_val=None, default=0):
    """
    Safely convert a value to an integer with optional
    range clamping.

    Args:
        value: Value to convert.
        min_val (int): Minimum allowed value.
        max_val (int): Maximum allowed value.
        default (int): Value returned on conversion failure.

    Returns:
        int: Safe integer value.
    """
    try:
        result = int(value)
        if min_val is not None:
            result = max(result, min_val)
        if max_val is not None:
            result = min(result, max_val)
        return result
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return default


def sanitize_float(value, min_val=None, max_val=None, default=0.0):
    """
    Safely convert a value to a float with optional
    range clamping.

    Args:
        value: Value to convert.
        min_val (float): Minimum allowed value.
        max_val (float): Maximum allowed value.
        default (float): Value returned on conversion failure.

    Returns:
        float: Safe float value.
    """
    try:
        result = float(value)
        if min_val is not None:
            result = max(result, min_val)
        if max_val is not None:
            result = min(result, max_val)
        return result
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return default


# =============================================================
# FILE SECURITY
# =============================================================

SAFE_MATERIAL_EXTENSIONS = {
    'mp4', 'webm', 'mkv', 'avi', 'mov',
    'pdf',
    'doc', 'docx', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'txt',
    'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp',
    'zip', 'rar',
}

SAFE_SUBMISSION_EXTENSIONS = {
    'pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'xls', 'xlsx',
    'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif',
    'zip', 'rar', 'txt', 'py', 'ipynb', 'csv',
}

SAFE_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {
    'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp'
}

# File signatures (magic bytes) for type verification
FILE_SIGNATURES = {
    b'\x25\x50\x44\x46':         'pdf',       # %PDF
    b'\x50\x4B\x03\x04':         'zip',       # PK
    b'\xFF\xD8\xFF':              'jpg',       # JPEG
    b'\x89\x50\x4E\x47':         'png',       # PNG
    b'\x47\x49\x46\x38':         'gif',       # GIF
    b'\x00\x00\x00\x18ftypmp42': 'mp4',       # MP4
    b'\x1A\x45\xDF\xA3':         'webm',      # WebM/MKV
}


def is_safe_file_extension(filename, allowed_set):
    """
    Check whether a filename has an extension in the
    allowed set.

    Args:
        filename (str): Filename to check.
        allowed_set (set): Set of allowed lowercase extensions.

    Returns:
        bool: True if the extension is allowed.
    """
    if not filename or '.' not in filename:
        return False
    ext = filename.rsplit('.', 1)[-1].lower().strip()
    return ext in allowed_set


def is_safe_file_size(file_obj, max_mb):
    """
    Check whether an uploaded file does not exceed
    the maximum size limit.

    Args:
        file_obj: Werkzeug FileStorage object.
        max_mb (int): Maximum allowed size in megabytes.

    Returns:
        bool: True if the file is within the size limit.
    """
    try:
        file_obj.seek(0, 2)       # Seek to end
        size_bytes = file_obj.tell()
        file_obj.seek(0)          # Reset position
        return size_bytes <= (max_mb * 1024 * 1024)
    except Exception:
        return False


def get_file_size_bytes(file_obj):
    """
    Get the size of an uploaded file in bytes.

    Args:
        file_obj: Werkzeug FileStorage object.

    Returns:
        int: File size in bytes, or 0 on error.
    """
    try:
        file_obj.seek(0, 2)
        size = file_obj.tell()
        file_obj.seek(0)
        return size
    except Exception:
        return 0


def verify_file_signature(file_obj):
    """
    Read the first 16 bytes of an uploaded file and
    attempt to identify its true type from its magic
    bytes signature, independent of the filename extension.

    This prevents extension spoofing attacks where a
    dangerous file is renamed with a safe extension.

    Args:
        file_obj: Werkzeug FileStorage object.

    Returns:
        str or None: Detected file type string, or None
                     if the signature is not recognized.
    """
    try:
        header = file_obj.read(16)
        file_obj.seek(0)

        for signature, file_type in FILE_SIGNATURES.items():
            if header.startswith(signature):
                return file_type

        return None

    except Exception:
        return None


def generate_secure_filename(original_filename):
    """
    Generate a cryptographically safe stored filename
    by prepending a UUID-based unique prefix to a
    sanitized version of the original filename.

    This prevents:
        - Filename collisions between uploads
        - Directory traversal via crafted filenames
        - Information leakage via predictable names

    Args:
        original_filename (str): Original filename from upload.

    Returns:
        str: UUID-prefixed safe stored filename.
    """
    import uuid
    safe_name     = sanitize_filename(original_filename)
    unique_prefix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
    return f'{unique_prefix}_{safe_name}'


# =============================================================
# URL AND REDIRECT SECURITY
# =============================================================

def is_safe_redirect_url(url):
    """
    Validate that a redirect URL is safe — that it points
    to the same host and does not redirect to an external
    domain, preventing open redirect vulnerabilities.

    Args:
        url (str): URL string to validate.

    Returns:
        bool: True if the URL is safe to redirect to.
    """
    if not url:
        return False

    # Must start with a single forward slash
    # Double slash // is a protocol-relative URL (unsafe)
    if not url.startswith('/') or url.startswith('//'):
        return False

    # Must not contain protocol indicators
    if '://' in url:
        return False

    # Must not contain backslashes (Windows path bypass)
    if '\\' in url:
        return False

    return True


def get_safe_next_url(default_url):
    """
    Extract and validate the 'next' URL parameter from the
    request, falling back to a safe default if the provided
    next URL is invalid or potentially malicious.

    Args:
        default_url (str): Safe fallback URL.

    Returns:
        str: Validated safe redirect URL.
    """
    next_url = request.args.get('next', '').strip()

    if next_url and is_safe_redirect_url(next_url):
        return next_url

    return default_url


# =============================================================
# SECURITY LOGGING
# =============================================================

def log_security_event(event_type, details=None, user_id=None):
    """
    Log a security-relevant event to the application logger.

    Security events include:
        - Failed login attempts
        - Access denied to restricted resources
        - Suspicious file upload attempts
        - CSRF validation failures
        - Password change attempts

    Args:
        event_type (str): Type of security event.
        details (str): Additional event details.
        user_id (int): ID of the user involved.
    """
    uid     = user_id or (current_user.id
                          if current_user.is_authenticated else 'anonymous')
    ip_addr = request.remote_addr if request else 'unknown'
    ua      = request.user_agent.string[:100] \
              if request and request.user_agent else 'unknown'

    log_msg = (
        f'[SECURITY] event={event_type} '
        f'user_id={uid} '
        f'ip={ip_addr} '
        f'path={request.path if request else "N/A"} '
        f'ua={ua}'
    )

    if details:
        log_msg += f' details={details}'

    logger.warning(log_msg)


def log_failed_login(email):
    """
    Log a failed login attempt with the attempted email.

    Args:
        email (str): Email address used in the failed attempt.
    """
    log_security_event(
        event_type='FAILED_LOGIN',
        details=f'email={sanitize_email(email)}'
    )


def log_access_denied(resource):
    """
    Log an unauthorized access attempt to a protected resource.

    Args:
        resource (str): The resource that was denied.
    """
    log_security_event(
        event_type='ACCESS_DENIED',
        details=f'resource={resource}'
    )

# =============================================================

def get_csp_header():
    """
    Generate a Content Security Policy header value.

    Returns:
        str: CSP header string for use in response headers.
    """
    return (
        "default-src 'self'; "
        "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' "
        "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; "
        "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; "
        "img-src 'self' data: https:; "
        "font-src 'self'; "
        "media-src 'self'; "
        "frame-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com "
        "https://drive.google.com; "
        "connect-src 'self'; "
        "object-src 'none';"
    )

# =============================================================
# Agri LMS — Input Validators
# =============================================================
# File    : app/utils/validators.py
# Purpose : Reusable server-side input validation functions
#           for all platform forms. Each validator returns
#           a tuple of (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str]).
# =============================================================

import re
from datetime import datetime


# =============================================================
# REGISTRATION FORM VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_registration(form_data):
    """
    Validate all fields in the learner registration form.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    full_name    = form_data.get('full_name', '').strip()
    email        = form_data.get('email', '').strip().lower()
    password     = form_data.get('password', '')
    confirm      = form_data.get('confirm_password', '')
    phone        = form_data.get('phone_number', '').strip()

    # Full name
    if not full_name:
        errors.append('Full name is required.')
    elif len(full_name) < 2:
        errors.append('Full name must be at least 2 characters.')
    elif len(full_name) > 150:
        errors.append('Full name must not exceed 150 characters.')
    elif re.search(r'[<>"\'{}|\\^`]', full_name):
        errors.append('Full name contains invalid characters.')

    # Email
    if not email:
        errors.append('Email address is required.')
    elif not re.match(r'^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$', email):
        errors.append('Please enter a valid email address.')
    elif len(email) > 150:
        errors.append('Email address is too long (max 150 characters).')

    # Password
    if not password:
        errors.append('Password is required.')
    elif len(password) < 8:
        errors.append('Password must be at least 8 characters long.')
    elif len(password) > 128:
        errors.append('Password must not exceed 128 characters.')
    elif password.isdigit():
        errors.append('Password must contain at least one letter.')
    elif password.isalpha():
        errors.append('Password must contain at least one number.')

    # Confirm password
    if password and confirm and password != confirm:
        errors.append('Passwords do not match. Please try again.')
    elif not confirm and password:
        errors.append('Please confirm your password.')

    # Phone (optional)
    if phone:
        cleaned = re.sub(r'[\s\-\+\(\)]', '', phone)
        if not cleaned.isdigit():
            errors.append(
                'Phone number must contain only digits, spaces, or hyphens.')
        elif len(cleaned) < 10 or len(cleaned) > 15:
            errors.append(
                'Phone number must be between 10 and 15 digits.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors


# =============================================================
# LOGIN FORM VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_login(form_data):
    """
    Validate the login form fields.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    email    = form_data.get('email', '').strip()
    password = form_data.get('password', '')

    if not email:
        errors.append('Email address is required.')
    elif not re.match(r'^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$', email):
        errors.append('Please enter a valid email address.')

    if not password:
        errors.append('Password is required.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors


# =============================================================
# COURSE FORM VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_course_form(form_data):
    """
    Validate the course creation and editing form.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    title       = form_data.get('title', '').strip()
    short_desc  = form_data.get('short_description', '').strip()
    pass_score  = form_data.get('passing_score', '').strip()
    dur_weeks   = form_data.get('duration_weeks', '').strip()
    max_enroll  = form_data.get('max_enrollments', '').strip()

    if not title:
        errors.append('Course title is required.')
    elif len(title) > 300:
        errors.append('Course title must not exceed 300 characters.')

    if not short_desc:
        errors.append('Short description is required.')
    elif len(short_desc) > 500:
        errors.append('Short description must not exceed 500 characters.')

    if pass_score:
        try:
            ps = float(pass_score)
            if ps < 0 or ps > 100:
                errors.append('Passing score must be between 0 and 100.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Passing score must be a valid number.')

    if dur_weeks:
        try:
            dw = int(dur_weeks)
            if dw < 1 or dw > 104:
                errors.append('Duration must be between 1 and 104 weeks.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Duration must be a valid whole number of weeks.')

    if max_enroll:
        try:
            me = int(max_enroll)
            if me < 1:
                errors.append('Maximum enrollments must be at least 1.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Maximum enrollments must be a valid number.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors


# =============================================================
# MODULE FORM VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_module_form(form_data):
    """
    Validate the module creation and editing form.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    title      = form_data.get('title', '').strip()
    course_id  = form_data.get('course_id', '').strip()
    order_num  = form_data.get('order_number', '').strip()
    duration   = form_data.get('duration_minutes', '').strip()

    if not title:
        errors.append('Module title is required.')
    elif len(title) > 300:
        errors.append('Module title must not exceed 300 characters.')

    if not course_id:
        errors.append('Please select a parent course.')
    else:
        try:
            int(course_id)
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Invalid course selection.')

    if order_num:
        try:
            on = int(order_num)
            if on < 1:
                errors.append('Order number must be at least 1.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Order number must be a whole number.')

    if duration:
        try:
            dm = int(duration)
            if dm < 1:
                errors.append('Duration must be at least 1 minute.')
            elif dm > 600:
                errors.append(
                    'Duration must not exceed 600 minutes (10 hours).')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Duration must be a whole number of minutes.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors


# =============================================================
# ASSIGNMENT FORM VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_assignment_form(form_data):
    """
    Validate the assignment creation and editing form.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    title       = form_data.get('title', '').strip()
    description = form_data.get('description', '').strip()
    course_id   = form_data.get('course_id', '').strip()
    total_marks = form_data.get('total_marks', '').strip()
    pass_mark   = form_data.get('pass_mark', '').strip()
    due_date    = form_data.get('due_date', '').strip()
    max_subs    = form_data.get('max_submissions', '').strip()

    if not title:
        errors.append('Assignment title is required.')
    elif len(title) > 300:
        errors.append('Assignment title must not exceed 300 characters.')

    if not description:
        errors.append('Assignment description is required.')

    if not course_id:
        errors.append('Please select a course for this assignment.')

    if total_marks:
        try:
            tm = float(total_marks)
            if tm <= 0:
                errors.append('Total marks must be greater than zero.')
            elif tm > 1000:
                errors.append('Total marks must not exceed 1000.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Total marks must be a valid number.')

    if pass_mark and total_marks:
        try:
            pm = float(pass_mark)
            tm = float(total_marks)
            if pm < 0:
                errors.append('Pass mark cannot be negative.')
            elif pm > tm:
                errors.append('Pass mark cannot exceed total marks.')
        except ValueError:
            pass  # Already caught by total_marks validation

    if due_date:
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(due_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M')
            if dt < datetime.utcnow():
                errors.append(
                    'Due date is in the past. '
                    'Consider setting a future date or leaving it blank.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append(
                'Due date format is invalid. '
                'Please use the date picker.')

    if max_subs:
        try:
            ms = int(max_subs)
            if ms < 1:
                errors.append('Maximum submissions must be at least 1.')
            elif ms > 10:
                errors.append(
                    'Maximum submissions must not exceed 10.')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Maximum submissions must be a whole number.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors


# =============================================================
# GRADE FORM VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_grade_form(form_data, total_marks):
    """
    Validate the grading form submission.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.
        total_marks (float): Maximum marks for the assignment.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    score_awarded = form_data.get('score_awarded', '').strip()

    if not score_awarded:
        errors.append('Please enter a score to award.')
    else:
        try:
            score = float(score_awarded)
            if score < 0:
                errors.append('Score cannot be negative.')
            elif total_marks and score > float(total_marks):
                errors.append(
                    f'Score ({score}) cannot exceed '
                    f'total marks ({total_marks}).')
        except ValueError:
            errors.append('Score must be a valid number.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors


# =============================================================
# PROFILE UPDATE VALIDATOR
# =============================================================

def validate_profile_update(form_data):
    """
    Validate the learner profile update form.

    Args:
        form_data (dict): Form data from request.form.

    Returns:
        tuple: (is_valid: bool, errors: list[str])
    """
    errors = []

    full_name = form_data.get('full_name', '').strip()
    phone     = form_data.get('phone_number', '').strip()
    bio       = form_data.get('bio', '').strip()

    if not full_name:
        errors.append('Full name is required.')
    elif len(full_name) < 2:
        errors.append('Full name must be at least 2 characters.')
    elif len(full_name) > 150:
        errors.append('Full name must not exceed 150 characters.')

    if phone:
        cleaned = re.sub(r'[\s\-\+\(\)]', '', phone)
        if not cleaned.isdigit():
            errors.append('Phone number must contain only digits.')
        elif len(cleaned) < 10 or len(cleaned) > 15:
            errors.append(
                'Phone number must be between 10 and 15 digits.')

    if bio and len(bio) > 500:
        errors.append('Bio must not exceed 500 characters.')

    return len(errors) == 0, errors

import logging
from logging.config import fileConfig

from flask import current_app

from alembic import context

# this is the Alembic Config object, which provides
# access to the values within the .ini file in use.
config = context.config

# Interpret the config file for Python logging.
# This line sets up loggers basically.
fileConfig(config.config_file_name)
logger = logging.getLogger('alembic.env')


def get_engine():
    try:
        # this works with Flask-SQLAlchemy<3 and Alchemical
        return current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.get_engine()
    except (TypeError, AttributeError):
        # this works with Flask-SQLAlchemy>=3
        return current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.engine


def get_engine_url():
    try:
        return get_engine().url.render_as_string(hide_password=False).replace(
            '%', '%%')
    except AttributeError:
        return str(get_engine().url).replace('%', '%%')


# add your model's MetaData object here
# for 'autogenerate' support
# from myapp import mymodel
# target_metadata = mymodel.Base.metadata
config.set_main_option('sqlalchemy.url', get_engine_url())
target_db = current_app.extensions['migrate'].db

# other values from the config, defined by the needs of env.py,
# can be acquired:
# my_important_option = config.get_main_option("my_important_option")
# ... etc.


def get_metadata():
    if hasattr(target_db, 'metadatas'):
        return target_db.metadatas[None]
    return target_db.metadata


def run_migrations_offline():
    """Run migrations in 'offline' mode.

    This configures the context with just a URL
    and not an Engine, though an Engine is acceptable
    here as well.  By skipping the Engine creation
    we don't even need a DBAPI to be available.

    Calls to context.execute() here emit the given string to the
    script output.

    """
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(
        url=url, target_metadata=get_metadata(), literal_binds=True
    )

    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online():
    """Run migrations in 'online' mode.

    In this scenario we need to create an Engine
    and associate a connection with the context.

    """

    # this callback is used to prevent an auto-migration from being generated
    # when there are no changes to the schema
    # reference: http://alembic.zzzcomputing.com/en/latest/cookbook.html
    def process_revision_directives(context, revision, directives):
        if getattr(config.cmd_opts, 'autogenerate', False):
            script = directives[0]
            if script.upgrade_ops.is_empty():
                directives[:] = []
                logger.info('No changes in schema detected.')

    conf_args = current_app.extensions['migrate'].configure_args
    if conf_args.get("process_revision_directives") is None:
        conf_args["process_revision_directives"] = process_revision_directives

    connectable = get_engine()

    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(
            connection=connection,
            target_metadata=get_metadata(),
            **conf_args
        )

        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()
